title: CRM & Data Operations Manager
description:
### **Din nya roll**


Vi söker nu en CRM & Data Operations Manager till vår kund. Här får du en viktig roll i att säkerställa att kunddata, målgruppsurval och kampanjleveranser fungerar smidigt och med hög kvalitet, samtidigt som verksamheten genomgår en omfattande transformation inom analys och marknadsteknik.


Du blir en del av ett team som stöttar företagets telemarketing- och kundkommunikationskanaler med kundsegmentering, målgruppsurval och dataleveranser till kampanjer inom flera affärsområden.


En central del av uppdraget är att säkerställa kontinuitet i befintliga, verksamhetskritiska processer samtidigt som äldre datalösningar successivt ersätts av modernare plattformar. Du får därmed möjlighet att både förvalta och förbättra befintliga arbetssätt och bidra till övergången mot nya tekniska lösningar.


I rollen ansvarar du för att kunddata och kampanjrelaterade processer fungerar effektivt, korrekt och tillförlitligt. Du arbetar både operativt med data och med att utveckla och automatisera processer.

**Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter innefattar att:**

* Hantera och genomföra kundsegmenteringar och målgruppsurval för olika kampanjer och kundkommunikationsinsatser.
* Säkerställa återkommande dataleveranser och kampanjunderlag.
* Förvalta, felsöka och vidareutveckla befintliga SQL-, R- och Teradata-baserade processer.
* Säkerställa hög datakvalitet, tillförlitliga leveranser och tydlig processdokumentation.
* Samarbeta nära verksamheten för att förstå behov och omsätta dessa till fungerande datauttag och lösningar.
* Bidra till migreringen från äldre datalösningar till moderna plattformar och verktyg, såsom GCP, Hightouch och Braze.
* Identifiera möjligheter till automatisering, effektivisering och förbättrade arbetsflöden.
* Säkerställa att verksamhetskritiska processer för kundkommunikation fortsätter att fungera under hela förändringsperioden.

### **Företagspresentation**


Vår kund är en ledande aktör inom telekommunikation i Sverige. Som medarbetare blir du del av en innovativ, tech-driven miljö där du får utveckla framtidens digitala lösningar och bidra till att skapa sömlösa och hållbara upplevelser för användare i hela Sverige.

### **Bra att känna till**

**Uppdragets omfattning**: Heltid, 100%  

**Anställningsform**: Tidsbegränsad anställning som konsult via JobBusters.  

**Arbetsmodell**: Hybrid  

**Start**: Så snart som möjligt.  

**Slut**: 2027-05-02, med möjlighet till förlängning  

**I din ansökan**: Säkerställ att det tydligt framgår att du är kvalificerad utefter kundens önskade kvalifikationer.

### **För att bli framgångsrik i denna roll behöver du**

* Gedigen erfarenhet av CRM, kunddata, kampanjoperationer eller dataanalys.
* Erfarenhet av att arbeta med stora kunddatabaser och komplexa datauttag.
* Avancerade kunskaper i SQL samt erfarenhet av R/RStudio.
* Mycket goda kunskaper i Excel och Power Query.
* Erfarenhet av Teradata eller motsvarande datalagerplattform.
* Erfarenhet av processautomation och effektivisering av dataflöden.
* Meriterande: Erfarenhet från telekombranschen, CRM- och Martech-miljöer eller tidigare migreringsprojekt.

**Det är särskilt värdefullt om du har erfarenhet av ett eller flera av följande verktyg och tekniker:**

* Hightouch och Braze.
* Google Cloud Platform (GCP) och BigQuery.
* Python eller andra verktyg för automatisering, exempelvis PowerShell.
* Power BI eller Looker.
* Git och versionshantering.
* Power Automate.


Du behöver inte nödvändigtvis behärska samtliga verktyg, men du har en god teknisk förståelse och lätt för att sätta dig in i nya system och arbetssätt.

### **Vi erbjuder**

* Trygg anställning med kollektivavtal, försäkringar och tjänstepension
* Friskvårdsbidrag samt personalrabatter och erbjudanden via Benifex (ex. inom hälsa, fritid, transport och sjukvård)
* Flexpension och tillgång till Lifeplan pensionstjänst
* Extra ersättning vid föräldraledighet
* Företagshälsovård
* Långsiktiga uppdrag och personlig kontakt med din konsultchef
* Möjlighet att bygga värdefull erfarenhet, nätverk och framtida utveckling

### **Välkommen med din ansökan**

  

Vi går igenom ansökningarna löpande. Då processerna i konsultvärlden ofta går snabbt kan tjänsten tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdatum – vänta därför inte med att skicka in din ansökan!


Du behöver inte skriva ett personligt brev utan i stället ber vi dig svara på urvalsfrågorna i samband med ansökan.

title: Thesis – Speech-to-Text on Edge IoT Device
description:
**Job Title**
-------------

Thesis – Speech-to-Text on Edge IoT Device
**Job Description**
-------------------


**Category**

Computer Science, Software

  

  

**Scope**

1-2 Master students, or 2 Bachelor students

  

  

**Background**

In an increasingly global and fast world, solutions for speech-to-text is a growing market. With the rise of AI, we have enhanced tools for making these pipelines more effective and accurate. This thesis project aims to explore speech-to-text of those pipelines and how AI can help us achieve that.

  

  

**Goal**

* Prototype: Develop a basic prototype of a speech-to-text module on an edge device using existing tools and available AI-models.
* Architectural study: Investigate the architecture of the live-translation pipeline from edge up to cloud.
* You will need to investigate different approaches while considering hardware performance limitations.
* The solution should also be easily available through modern version control or other tools.
  

  

**Who are you?**

Master's or Bachelor student in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.

  

  

**OK, I am interested! What do I do now?**

You are valuable to us – how nice that you are interested in one of our proposals! There are a few things for you to keep in mind when applying.


* Applications are accepted in both Swedish and English, and you apply via the proposal advert.
* The announced thesis is open only to students affiliated with a Swedish University/College either directly or via an exchange program.
* When the thesis proposal states that it includes two students working together, we would like you to apply in pairs. In these cases, send one application each but make sure to clearly state in your application who your co-applicant is. If you have any questions regarding this, please do not hesitate to contact us.

title: Lifecycle Assurance Manager
description:
My name is Jim Hast, and I am the Head of Customer Experience for our team in the Northern Region at Telia Cygate. We are now looking for a **Senior Lifecycle Assurance Manager** to join our office in Gävle.

  

  

As a Lifecycle Assurance Manager, you will turn technology investments into lasting customer value. Are you motivated by bringing structure to complex IT environments and turning insights into clear action? Join Telia Cygate as a Lifecycle Assurance Manager and help customers optimise their hardware, software, licences and service agreements throughout the technology lifecycle.

  

  

**What you’ll do:**

  

In this role, you will help customers maximise the return on their technology investments, reduce the risk of downtime and optimise licensing and software costs. By connecting accurate asset and contract information with proactive lifecycle planning, you will turn operational insights into practical recommendations that support long-term business goals.

  

  

Your responsibilities will include:

  

  

* **Create visibility and control** : Review vendor and partner portals quarterly, reconcile active licences and hardware records, remove outdated entries and identify gaps in service and support coverage.
* **Stay ahead of lifecycle risks** : Track End-of-Life, End-of-Service and other key milestones, and coordinate renewals to help prevent lapses in licences and support agreements.
* **Optimise usage and costs** : Analyse software and licence usage, identify unused entitlements and underused functionality, and recommend appropriate licence and support levels.
* **Build actionable roadmaps** : Develop and maintain rolling 24-month plans for software upgrades, functionality and hardware replacement, aligned with each customer’s IT platform roadmap.
* **Support service-level management** : Review service and support coverage against business criticality, monitor security patches, bug fixes and software versions, and highlight potential additional costs associated with version changes.
* **Turn insights into improvement** : Identify opportunities for assessments, best-practice initiatives and use cases that help customers get more value from their technology.
* **Contribute to strategic advice** : Support planning for cloud and SaaS adoption, automation, observability, AI and infrastructure evolution, taking security, application sovereignty and data sovereignty into account.
* **Enable more efficient governance** : Assess tools and automation opportunities to improve the monitoring and management of portals, assets and software versions.
* **Connect technology with business priorities** : Bring lifecycle insights and recommendations to Quarterly Business Reviews, linking customer goals and security requirements to a 24–60-month planning horizon.
  

  

**What will help you thrive in this role:**

  

You combine analytical thinking with technical understanding and a clear, customer-focused communication style. You enjoy making complex information manageable, explaining risks and opportunities, and turning your findings into prioritised recommendations. Your background may be in IT lifecycle management, software licensing, hardware asset management, service and support agreements, or customer-facing IT advisory work. An interest in governance, automation and long-term technology planning helps you connect operational detail with business value.

  

  

Your experience and skills:

  

  

* **Customer advisory experience** : Several years in a customer-facing advisory role, with the ability to understand customer needs, explain technical topics clearly and build trusted relationships.
* **IT and infrastructure experience** : A background in the IT industry and an understanding of how hardware, software and service and support agreements fit together throughout the technology lifecycle.
* **Licensing and software knowledge** : An understanding of software licensing, entitlements and product functionality, and how these affect customer usage and costs. Familiarity with Cisco’s product portfolio is an advantage.
* **A data-driven approach** : Experience using data and insights to create ongoing customer value, with the ability to organize asset, license and contract information, identify risks and opportunities, and translate findings into clear actions.
* **Excellent communication skills** , with fluency in Swedish (native or near-native) and good English to communicate clearly with customers and colleagues.
  

  

**Additional requirements**

  

Telia is part of critical infrastructure and parts of our operations are subject to security protection. Depending on the role, vetting activities may be required prior to employment. In some cases, additional eligibility requirements, including specific citizenship requirements, may apply.

  

  

**Why Telia Cygate?**  



  

At Telia Cygate, we’re not only experts in networks, security, and various types of cloud solutions – we’re also a team that believes work should be fun! As part of Telia Company, we have the strength to create real impact on a large scale, contribute to societal value, and help our customers navigate the world of digitalization. And we always do it with warmth, care, and a smile. Here, it’s our ideas and diverse perspectives that make us strong, and together we ensure that the world of technology becomes a place where everyone feels good – and where you belong.

  

  

Your development matters to us. We encourage continuous learning and make sure that you and your interests are in focus. We know that people are the heart of our company, which is why we value joy, creativity, and different perspectives in everything we do.

  

  

Welcome to grow together with us – where we make technology human and create real impact!

  

  

**Telia Cygate is proud to be certificated as Great Place to Work!**  



  

With us, people are at the center – here you get the chance to grow, be challenged, and thrive together with dedicated colleagues. We are building a culture where security, togetherness, and opportunities go hand in hand. Do you want to be part of the journey? Welcome to a workplace that truly lives up to its name.

  

  

**What we offer**  



  

When you join us, you'll receive a comprehensive benefits package tailored to your local market, opportunities for remote work, and more. Join us to make technology work for people and turn your expertise into lasting customer value.

  

  

**Interested? Apply!**

  

We look forward to receiving your application by **2026-11-15.** Please note that we might close the position earlier if we find the right candidate, so don’t wait too long to apply!

  

  

**Location: Gävle**

  

If you’re selected for the next stage, you’ll be contacted by our **Talent Acquisition Partner.**  

Background and reference checks will be part of the process.

  

  

Want to know more about this role? Please reach out to Jim Hast on 076-1058119 or at jim.hast@cygate.se .

  

  

We kindly ask recruitment agencies and external vendors not to contact us regarding this position.

  

  

**Equal opportunities**

  

At Telia, we recognize talent by professional skills and growth potential. We champion diversity, ensuring every individual’s needs are met, regardless of disability, gender, age, nationality, sexual orientation, or social status. Together, we’re dedicated to fostering an inclusive work environment where your uniqueness is our strength.

  

  

**Welcome to Telia Cygate – Home of Experts**

Viedoc is a Swedish medtech company offering a clinical trials platform. It supports clinical studies in over 100 countries and is trusted by some of the largest pharmaceutical companies in the world. Our cloud-based platform holds sensitive medical data for millions of patients, so security and reliability come first.

You’ll own the database infrastructure behind our product, from availability and access to performance, and help us run it as code. We’re an enabling team that builds and runs our infrastructure in Azure, from landing zones and governance to containers, networking and security, giving our developers and data teams a secure, reliable platform to build on. We work in an agile way, often pair up to solve problems, and AI is a natural part of our daily work.

**What your day-to-day could look like:**

* Manage our MySQL, PostgreSQL and Redis databases, from high availability to disaster recovery
* Keep the database platform secure, audit-ready and performant, together with our developers
* Enable our new data warehouse team with the infrastructure, access and pipelines they build on
* Build infrastructure as code, CI/CD pipelines and automation
* Contribute to Azure governance and landing zone architecture
* Work across the wider platform, from containers to networking and security

Azure, Bicep, Azure DevOps/GitHub, PowerShell, MySQL/PostgreSQL, Azure Managed Redis, AI assistants

* You’ve got a strong background as a DBA or in a similar role
* You have hands-on experience with Redis or another in-memory data store
* You have experience with scripting, ideally PowerShell
* You have a doer mindset, enjoy teamwork and share what you learn
* You’re fluent in English

**Bonus if you have:**

* Experience with Azure in production environments
* Working knowledge of infrastructure as code, ideally Bicep
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines, ideally in Azure DevOps or GitHub

*Don’t tick every box? Apply anyway. We care more about a strong database foundation and curiosity than a perfect match.*

**Why Viedoc:**

title: Mall
description:
**Om oss**  

På Techrytera AB börjar rekryteringen med dig. Vi är ett bemannings- och rekryteringsföretag med spetskompetens och ett tydligt fokus inom IT och Engineering. title: Postdoctor in Tropical Forest Ecology, Terrestrial Laser Scanning and Forest Biomass Dynamics
description:
The University of Gothenburg tackles society’s challenges with diverse knowledge. 58 000 students and 6800 employees make the university a large and inspiring place to work and study. Strong research and attractive study programmes attract researchers and students from around the world. With new knowledge and new perspectives, the University contributes to a better future.


At the Department of Biological and Environmental Sciences (BioEnv) we have teaching and research activities that stretch from the alpine ecosystem, through forests, cultivated land and streams, all the way into the marine environment. In these environments we study different levels of biological organisation from genes, individuals and populations, to communities and ecosystems. We work within ecology, evolution, physiology, systematics and combinations of these fields in order to understand the impact of natural and anthropogenic changes of the environment.


The department is placed at two different localities: in Natrium at Medicinaregatan 7B in Gothenburg and at the Kristineberg marine research station operated by the Marine Infrastructure at the University of Gothenburg. The current position is placed at Natrium.


**We offer**


The University of Gothenburg is a state authority, which means special benefits, more holidays and a great pension. You can read more about our employment benefits here.


**Subject area**

Tropical Forest Ecology, Terrestrial Laser Scanning and Forest Biomass Dynamics


**Subject area description**


Forests gain and lose biomass not only through tree growth and mortality, but also when living trees lose branches or parts of their crowns and subsequently recover. These non-lethal fluxes are largely invisible to conventional forest inventories and are therefore poorly represented in forest carbon budgets. This postdoctor position is part of TWIG, a five-year ERC Starting Grant project that will combine repeated terrestrial laser scanning (TLS) with long-term forest inventories to directly quantify damage, recovery and biomass redistribution in tropical forests. The postdoctor will lead the methodological work that converts multi-temporal 3D point clouds into robust estimates of tree- and stand-level biomass change.


**Duties**


The main aim of the position is to develop, validate and apply the TLS-to-aboveground-biomass (AGB) workflow that underpins TWIG. The postdoctor will contribute to TLS data acquisition at the project sites. The postdoctor will compare TLS-derived biomass estimates with conventional allometric approaches and develop reproducible stand-level carbon-balance calculations that include branch turnover and regrowth. The position will also quantify differences between TLS-based and traditional inventory estimates of biomass stocks, gains, losses and net fluxes.


Field and analytical work will focus on two intensively monitored tropical forests: Amacayacu in the Colombian Amazon and Alto da Figueira in the Brazilian Atlantic Forest. The postdoctor will work closely with the PI, a PhD student, MSc and BSc students, local field teams, and international collaborators. The work will involve large 3D datasets and reproducible computational workflows, including scripted quality control and, when appropriate, parallel processing on high-performance computing infrastructure. The project includes training and scientific exchange with leading TLS researchers and forest ecologists, as well as participation in international meetings and conferences.


The successful applicant will contribute to cross-training within the TWIG team and will have opportunities to co-supervise MSc and BSc students working with forest inventory and TLS. The position is strongly collaborative and combines method development, field data acquisition, computational analysis and scientific publication.


The postdoctor will be hosted at the Department of Biological and Environmental Sciences under the main supervision of Dr. Daniel Zuleta. The project is connected to international forest research and monitoring initiatives including ForestGEO, GEO-TREES, the Alliance for Tropical Forest Science Mortality Working Group, and the strategic research area BECC.


**Eligibility**

The eligibility criteria for employing teaching staff are set out in Chapter 4 of the Higher Education Ordinance and in the Appointment Procedure for Teaching Posts at the University of Gothenburg.


To be eligible for appointment as a postdoc, the applicant is required to have a doctoral degree, a doctoral degree in art or a foreign degree that is deemed to be equivalent to a doctoral degree. This eligibility requirement must be met before the employment decision is made.


In the first instance, those who have completed their degree no more than three years prior to the end of the application period shall be considered. Those who have completed their degree more than three years prior to the end of the application period may also be considered in the first instance if special grounds exist. Special grounds relate to leave of absence due to illness, parental leave, commissions of trust within union organisations, service within the defence services or other similar circumstances, as well as clinical service or service/assignment relevant to the subject area.


**Assessment criteria**


Required qualifications for the employment:


* To be eligible for appointment as a postdoc, the applicant is required to have a doctoral degree in Biology, Ecology, Forest Engineering or another relevant subject
* Excellent communication skills, written and spoken, in English are necessary since we work in an international environment.
* Strong quantitative and computational skills for processing and analyzing large ecological datasets
* Documented experience with terrestrial laser scanning (TLS) data acquisition and processing
* Experience with scientific programming or scripting and reproducible data-analysis workflows
* Willingness and ability to conduct extended field work in tropical countries, including Colombia and Brazil

Desirable qualifications for the employment:


* A strong track record of scientific publications related to terrestrial laser scanning, forest remote sensing, forest biomass, forest structure and/or forest ecology
* Experience with individual-tree segmentation, quantitative structure models (QSMs), or comparable 3D reconstruction approaches
* Experience with forest biomass estimation, tree allometry, uncertainty propagation and/or forest inventory data
* Experience with quantitative analysis and programming in R, Python or similar languages, and/or high-performance or batch-computing workflows
* Fieldwork experience in tropical forests and under remote or logistically challenging conditions
* Language skills in Spanish or Portuguese, or willingness to learn one of these languages

**The application should be written in English and must include:**


* A cover letter with the applicant’s justification for the application, i.e., that describes how the applicant meets the selection criteria (no more than one page)
* A list of qualifications (CV) (no more than three pages)
* Certificate of PhD exam
* Complete list of publications, including submitted and accepted manuscripts

The most qualified candidates, in relation to the assessment criteria in the advertisement, are invited for an interview.


**Employment**


The employment is a temporary employment for three years, 100 % of full time, placed at the Department of Biological and Environmental Science. Starting date February 1st, 2027, or upon agreement.


**Contact information**
  

If you have any questions about the position, please contact:


Daniel Zuleta, Associate Senior Lecturer
  

Email: daniel.zuleta@bioenv.gu.se
  

Webpage: https://www.gu.se/en/about/find-staff/danielzuleta


Åsa Arrhenius, Head of Department
  

Tel. +46 31 786 26 25

If you have any questions about the employment process, please contact HR at the Department of Biological and Environmental Science, hr@bioenv.gu.se


**Unions**

Union representatives at the University of Gothenburg can be found here: https://www.gu.se/om-universitetet/jobba-hos-oss/hjalp-for-sokande


**Application**


Submit your application via the University of Gothenburg’s recruitment portal by clicking the “Apply” button. It is your responsibility to ensure that the application is complete as per the vacancy notice, and that the University receives it by the final application deadline.


**Please read more about the position here:** Göteborgs universitet | Postdoctor in Tropical Forest Ecology, Terrestrial Laser Scanning and Forest Biomass Dynamics


Publications that cannot be attached to the application in digital format should be mailed in single copy to:


Department of Biological and Environmental Science

**Information for International Applicants**


Choosing a career in a foreign country is a big step. Thus, to give you a general idea of what we and Gothenburg have to offer in terms of benefits and life in general for you and your family/spouse/partner please visit:

title: Research Scientist

Collective Minds is looking for a Research Scientist to drive scientific and technical contributions in public and private research consortia. This is an opportunity to combine research, technology and project ownership in a growing international healthtech company.

**About Collective Minds**
--------------------------


Collective Minds is based in Stockholm/Danderyd and we operate globally across clinical trials and life sciences. We are an imaging platform for clinical trials that connects hospitals, experts, and industry - including CROs, pharma, biotech, medtech, and eClinical vendors - enabling trials with imaging endpoints and the generation of high-quality evidence faster and more efficiently. We are a fast-moving, commercially minded team focused on collaboration, accountability, and impact. By combining deep domain expertise in medical imaging with novel cloud technology, we help customers reduce risk, ensure compliance, accelerate and scale research.

**About the role**
------------------


As Research Scientist, you will combine scientific expertise in medical imaging with hands-on technical development and ownership of selected research consortia.


Collective Minds currently participates in more than 10 public and private research consortia spanning medical imaging, big data, analytics and AI modeling and validation. These collaborations bring together academic hospitals, research organizations and industry partners across therapeutic areas such as oncology, immunology, cardiovascular and musculoskeletal research.


Acting as a data manager and platform provider, Collective Minds plays a central role in these collaborations. You will be responsible for our contributions in two to three consortia, with the opportunity to apply your scientific and technical expertise, work independently and contribute to impactful research.

*Your main responsibilities:*

* Lead Collective Minds' contributions in selected research consortia, ensuring delivery within agreed budgets, timelines and scope.
* Develop and implement technical solutions, including scripts, data pipelines, analytical tools, dashboards and AI-based applications.

title: Director Research Programs & Consortia
description:
**Are you a business-minded research professional with deep expertise in medical imaging who thrives in a fast-moving, entrepreneurial environment?**

**Do you enjoy combining scientific and technical expertise with commercial understanding, taking ownership and driving complex research collaborations towards successful outcomes?**

**Collective Minds is looking for a Director, Research Programs & Consortia to drive our portfolio of public and private research collaborations. This is a broad, hands-on role with significant responsibility and the opportunity to make a real impact in a growing international healthtech company.**

**About Collective Minds**
--------------------------

*Collective Minds is based in Stockholm/Danderyd and we operate globally across clinical trials and life sciences. We are an imaging platform for clinical trials that connects hospitals, experts, and industry - including CROs, pharma, biotech, medtech, and eClinical vendors - enabling trials with imaging endpoints and the generation of high-quality evidence faster and more efficiently. We are a fast-moving, commercially minded team focused on collaboration, accountability, and impact. By combining deep domain expertise in medical imaging with novel cloud technology, we help customers reduce risk, ensure compliance, accelerate and scale research.*

**About the role**
------------------


As Director, Research Programs & Consortia, you will take responsibility for our portfolio of more than 10 public and private research consortia, which are a key part of Collective Minds' strategy and ongoing delivery.


Working alongside CROs, biotech and medtech companies, pharmaceutical partners, academic hospitals and research organizations, these collaborations span medical imaging, big data, analytics, and AI modeling and validation across therapeutic areas such as oncology, immunology, cardiovascular and musculoskeletal research.


Within these projects, Collective Minds acts as a data manager and platform provider, bringing deep expertise in medical imaging to support complex research collaborations.


You will be responsible for successful project delivery, reporting and project close-outs, while coordinating project and research managers across our customer delivery organization. This is a broad, hands-on role where you will combine scientific expertise with commercial understanding, set priorities and drive results through collaboration. You will ensure projects are delivered efficiently, within agreed scope and with a clear focus on quality and business value.

You are analytical, pragmatic and comfortable working independently in a fast-moving environment. You enjoy collaborating across disciplines, making decisions and finding effective solutions without adding unnecessary complexity.


You communicate clearly, build trust with internal and external stakeholders and know how to balance scientific quality with business priorities and efficient execution.

*We believe you have:*

* Hands-on experience with research consortia, work package delivery, grant writing, grant execution and funding-related reporting.

* Commercial awareness and the ability to balance scientific objectives with budgets, resources and project commitments.
* Strong communication, coordination and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to drive results across teams and external partners.
* A proactive, hands-on and solution-oriented approach, with the ability to adapt quickly and take initiative.
* Fluency in English, both written and spoken.

title: Praktik på Kommunikationsavdelning
description:
**Är du kreativ och engagerad i kvinnors rättigheter? Vill du arbeta med kommunikation i ett team som varje dag når ut till tusentals följare i sociala medier och arbetar datadrivet för att öka trafik och engagemang?**

**Kvinna till Kvinna befinner sig i en spännande och intensiv fas för att öka kännedomen om vårt arbete för kvinnors rättigheter, engagera en bredare målgrupp och stärka vår insamling från både privatpersoner, institutioner och företag. Därför söker vi nu en praktikant till vårt arbete på vår enhet kommunikation och insamling där du blir en del av det dagliga arbetet på kommunikationsavdelningen. Vi erbjuder en internationell, professionell och kreativ arbetsplats.**

#### **Om Kvinna till Kvinna**


Kvinna till Kvinna har arbetat för kvinnors rättigheter världen över i över 30 år. I dag är vi en av världens ledande kvinnorättsorganisationer och samarbetar med över 100 partnerorganisationer i 20 länder. Vi arbetar i Europa, Afrika, Södra Kaukasien och Mellanöstern.

**Det här erbjuder vi**


Hos Kvinna till Kvinna får du möjlighet att fördjupa dina kunskaper om kommunikation och internationellt arbete för kvinnors rättigheter. Du får värdefull inblick i det dagliga arbetet med kommunikation och insamling på en kvinnorättsorganisation. Du får också vara med och bidra till ökad kännedom om och engagemang för arbetet för kvinnors rättigheter i världens krigs- och konfliktdrabbade områden.

#### **Om praktiken**


Du blir en del av det dagliga arbetet inom kommunikation och insamling. Du får en egen handledare och deltar i teamets löpande planering och möten.

**Praktikuppgifter**

* Stötta med research inför kommunikationsinsatser och årsrapport.
* Vara delaktig i planering och genomförande av olika givarevent .
* Ta fram innehåll för sociala medier och webb.
* Skriva artiklar för webb.
* Stötta i uppföljning och moderering av Kvinna till Kvinnas sociala mediekanaler.
* Vara delaktig i utvecklingen av Kvinna till Kvinnas webbplatser.
* Samla in, strukturera och paketera berättelser och resultat från verksamheten.
* Bidra i det löpande arbetet.

#### **Om dig**


Vi önskar att du är självgående, lösningsorienterad och kreativ. Du trivs med att arbeta i team och har ett genuint intresse för kommunikation. Om du dessutom tycker om att utvecklas och dela med dig av det du lär dig har du kommit rätt.


Dessutom delar du våra värderingar: Courage, Commitment, och Credibility. Dessa värderingar vägleder oss i arbetet med att omfamna mångfald, tillämpa ett intersektionellt feministiskt perspektiv och utmana orättvisor.

**Du behöver ha**

* Studier inom marknadsföring, kommunikation, journalistik eller annan relevant utbildning, med ett starkt intresse för kommunikation.
* God förmåga att uttrycka dig i text och bild.
* Flytande svenska, i tal och skrift.
* Goda kunskaper i engelska, i tal och skrift.

**Meriterande**

* Studier eller annat engagemang relaterat till Kvinna till Kvinnas verksamhet såsom jämställdhet, kvinnors rättigheter, fred.
* Erfarenhet av sociala medier.
* Erfarenhet av eventplanering.
* Kunskaper i layout, till exempel i Adobe Creative Cloud.
* Erfarenhet av att redigera rörligt material, till exempel i Premiere Pro.
* Erfarenhet av foto och bildredigering, till exempel i Photoshop.

#### **Omfattning och villkor**


Praktiken är oavlönad, på heltid och omfattar 20 veckor under vårterminen 2027.


Vi ser gärna att du söker praktik som en del av dina pågående studier och att du får ersättning via CSN eller annan offentlig finansiering. Om så inte är fallet behöver du ange hur din praktik finansieras.


Vi skriver praktikavtal och du omfattas av försäkring under hela praktikperioden.


Praktiken är placerad på Kvinna till Kvinnas huvudkontor i Stockholm. Vi arbetar i hybridformat och kombinerar kontorsarbete med distansarbete.

#### **Ansökan**


För att ansöka vill vi att du skickar in personligt brev, CV och, om relevant, portfolio. Skriv din ansökan på svenska. Observera att vi endast tar emot ansökningar via vår karriärsida.

**Sista ansökningsdag: 5 november 2026**

#### **Frågor**


Om du har frågor om praktikplatsen är du välkommen att kontakta Alexandra Karlsdotter Stenström på alexandra.karlsdotter@kvinnatillkvinna.se.


För övriga frågor om rekryteringsprocessen, kontakta HR officer på hr@kvinnatillkvinna.se.

title: Strategic Product Manager, Autonomous Network / Cloud RAN | Early Career Program
description:
**About this opportunity**
--------------------------



Ericsson’s Early Career Program is an 18-month journey for you who are recently graduated or have up to five years of relevant experience. Through three rotations, including one international and market exposure, you will tackle challenges that matter, work alongside people who expect you to contribute, question, and move things forward.

  

The accelerated track is designed to develop future leaders who are motivated by performance, pace, and commercial impact. You’ll rotate across a range of functions such as Sales, Commercial Management, Sourcing, Strategy, Supply, Finance and more. Working on priorities that directly influence results and learning how different parts of the business connect to create value.

  

This isn’t a program where you sit on the sideline. From day one, you’re hired permanently into a role, trusted to contribute, supported to grow, and expected to make an impact. Find out more about the Early Career program here.

  

Your journey within the **Early Career Program** will start as a **Strategic Product Manager**

**About the team**
------------------



Join Ericsson's Strategic Product Management team focusing on Architecture, Automation and Operations, within Product Line RAN Software. Our team consists of around 10 people, primarily based in Stockholm, working on how AI, automation, and next-generation RAN technologies will shape the future of mobile networks.

  

This Strategic Product Manager role offers two possible focus areas, depending on your background and the needs of the business:

* **Autonomous Networks:** shaping product strategy for AI-enabled network operations, automation, and autonomous network capabilities.
* **Cloud RAN Infrastructure:** shaping product strategy for the cloud-native infrastructure, RAN compute, and technologies underpinning next-generation RAN.

  

In either area, you will contribute to portfolio strategy, influence product direction, and identify business opportunities. You will work closely with Product Units, Engineering Units, sales and market teams, customers, and industry partners to connect emerging technologies with customer needs and business value.

  

You will be part of a team that encourages curiosity, challenges existing thinking, and works across organizations to turn new technologies into meaningful business opportunities.

 **Why Join Us?**

* **Shape the Future of Networks** – Contribute to Ericsson’s vision of building intelligent, resilient, and future-ready networks.
* **Turn Innovation into Business Value** – Leverage AI, automation, and cloud infrastructure to deliver meaningful business outcomes for customers worldwide.
* **Influence the Future of Network Innovation** – Contribute to portfolio strategy and product evolution at one of the world’s leading telecommunications companies.
* **Collaborate with Industry Leaders** – Engage with leading operators, strategic partners, and technology thought leaders across the global ecosystem.
* **Drive Impact and Growth** – Take ownership of meaningful strategic initiatives with significant business impact while growing professionally within a diverse, highly skilled Stockholm-based team with global reach.
**What you will do**
--------------------



As a Strategic Product Manager, you will connect technology, customer needs, and commercial strategy. Drawing on hands-on product or solution experience, you will help shape Ericsson’s offering, portfolio positioning, and product direction to create customer and business value.

  

Your work will reflect your assigned focus area. You will have the opportunity to:

* Contribute to and drive strategic initiatives, translating technology developments, market trends, and customer needs into business opportunities for next-generation RAN.
* Contribute to portfolio strategy and roadmaps by developing differentiated product offerings, clear value propositions, customer stories, and recommendations on product direction and investments.
* Support strategic planning and execution through IPP and SPP processes, developing business cases, commercial recommendations, actionable plans, and following initiatives through implementation.
* Identify growth opportunities through customer engagement, market intelligence, competitive analysis, technology insights, and translate findings into compelling customer stories.
* Work across Product Units, Engineering Units, Market Areas, customers, and industry partners to align product strategies with customer needs and business priorities.
* Contribute to industry discussions, presentations, and relevant standardization forums, helping connect strategic priorities with customer and business outcomes.
**What you will bring**
-----------------------



Shared experience and capabilities

* 2-5 years of relevant experience in telecommunications, product development, data science, commercial strategy, or related technology fields.
* Experience understanding products or offerings and connecting customer needs, technology trends, and market insights to business value and commercial opportunities.
* Hands-on experience with products, solutions, or their implementation.
* Experience working across teams and driving initiatives forward with different stakeholders.
* Strong analytical, communication, and presentation skills, with the ability to adapt messages to different audiences.
* Curiosity, ownership, and confidence to challenge existing ways of working

  

Focus 1 — Autonomous Networks

* Hands-on experience in network operations, implementing automation solutions, or developing data-driven and AI-enabled solutions.
* Understanding of network operations from an operator or user perspective, with exposure to areas such as network assurance, orchestration, or automation.
* Understanding of how automation and AI can improve network performance and operational efficiency.

  

Focus 2 — Cloud RAN Infrastructure

* Hands-on experience with cloud infrastructure, compute platforms, or real-time applications.
* Understanding of cloud technologies and infrastructure, with exposure to platforms or technologies such as Intel, NVIDIA, Red Hat OpenShift, CNIS, or Kubernetes.
* Understanding of infrastructure performance and how cloud technologies support next-generation network solutions.

  

You are expected to bring relevant experience in one of these focus areas, not both. We also welcome candidates with backgrounds in data science or commercial strategy who can demonstrate relevant product or technical understanding.

**Why join Ericsson?**At Ericsson, you´ll have an outstanding opportunity. The chance to use your skills and imagination to push the boundaries of what´s possible. To build solutions never seen before to some of the world’s toughest problems. You´ll be challenged, but you won’t be alone. You´ll be joining a team of diverse innovators, all driven to go beyond the status quo to craft what comes next.

We truly believe that by collaborating with people with different experiences we drive innovation, which is essential for our future growth. title: Cloud Engineer
description:
We’re looking for a
 **Cloud Engineer** 
 who enjoys working in the space where developers and infrastructure meet. Here, you’ll spend your time automating the mundane, architecting the complex, and scaling the future of our Azure AI and OpenAI offerings. This role is for you if you find more joy in writing a PowerShell script to solve a recurring app error than in managing a cluster’s networking.
   

  

 This is a code-centric role where infrastructure is treated as a software product. Everything you build is versioned, reviewed, tested, and continuously improved. Our goal is to reduce repetitive work and create the “Golden Paths” that let developers and AI teams deploy quickly, securely, and reliably.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As a Cloud Engineer, you’ll help build and grow our Azure-based platform. You’ll own the design, automation, and delivery of modular cloud infrastructure, ensuring it’s resilient, scalable, and easy for teams to use. Your work will reduce friction, remove unnecessary steps, and make it simple for developers and data teams to focus on building features instead of worrying about infrastructure.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Build the "Golden Path" Pipelines: You won't just "run" pipelines; you will architect them. You’ll design and maintain CI/CD templates (YAML-based) that standardize how our applications are built, tested, and deployed. Your goal is to make the path from code-complete to production-ready as invisible and frictionless as possible for our developers.
* Automated Application Remediation: We don't believe in manual maintenance. You will use PowerShell and Azure DevOps to build automated pipelines for things like patching the container OS, reporting on deviations and self healing infrastructure
* Infrastructure as Versioned Code: You’ll design and implement modular Azure infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code (Bicep), following the Azure Well-Architected Framework for reliability, performance, and cost.


**We Are Looking For You Who Have**
* Expert-level PowerShell skills: We operate in an environment where automation is built on PowerShell first. (Bash & Python are secondary)
* Proven experience with Azure Bicep: You should be comfortable treating infrastructure as a software product, versioning, testing and modularizing Bicep code.
* Developer-centric approach: You don't need to be a fullstack developer, but you need to understand application logic enough to automate patching, troubleshoot database connections, and optimize application performance within the cloud.
* Fluency in English (written and spoken).


 You’ll be comfortable owning tasks end to end and making technical decisions independently within the areas listed above. Ideally, you have some years of hands-on experience with Azure, containers, and CI/CD pipelines, but we care more about what you can do and that you enjoy the field, rather than the exact number of years.
   

  

**It's Positive If You Have**
* Active Azure certifications such as AZ-400 (DevOps Engineer), AZ-305 (Solutions Architect), AZ-204 (Developer Associate)
* Experience from regulated or security-conscious environments is a plus


 In addition to this, it is important to us that you recognize yourself in our values: we are wholehearted, we collaborate and we take the lead.
   

  

 Read more about NOBA Benefits here: https://careers.noba.bank/pages/information
   

  

**Have you heard of NOBAVERSE?**
 In our NOBAVERSE, we value openness, trust, and diversity. Here, you can influence your own development and have fun along the way to achieving our goals – all in a workplace that’s a little extra
 *bubbly* 
 ! ✨
   

  

 Read more about our employee value proposition on our careers page.
   

  

**Read more about how our recruitment process works in the** 
**FAQ** 
**.**
 We care for your privacy and, with reference to the GDPR, would like to ask you not to include any sensitive personal data in your application, for examples information about ethnic origin, political opinions, religious beliefs or information about your health.
   

  

**Read more about how we handle your personal data** 
**here** 
**.**
 If you have any questions or concerns about the position, please contact the responsible recruiter.
   

  

 We look forward to receiving your application! 🙏✨

title: ProServe Area Delivery Leader, Professional Services
description:
**Description**
 The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is looking for an experienced ProServe Area Delivery Leader (PADL) to join our Shared Delivery Team (SDT). This senior leadership role is responsible for all delivery activities within the Area (single/multi-country or Practice/Industry), ensuring optimal support while maximizing team utilization and revenue performance. You'll report to the Geo Delivery Leader serving as a strategic advisor to customers, partners, and internal AWS teams.
   

  

 As PADLs you will coach, manage, and guide Delivery Practice Managers (DPMs) and their teams, to ensure they are providing best in class solutions for customers and partners. Routinely engaging with C-level executives within our customers, you will be responsible for ensuring Area SDTs work closely with partner teams; drive business development initiatives through thought leadership; provide portfolio guidance and oversight; and meet and exceed customer satisfaction targets. PADLs primarily drive their teams to partner with ProServe Account Executives to identify, understand, and define business outcomes for customers by building trust, identifying applicable AWS Professional Services offerings, and successfully executing SOWs.
   

  

 Your experience gained leading teams within the technology sector, will equip you with the ability to optimize team growth and performance through implementing tailored people development plans, ensuring Area SDTs are aligned to customer needs, and have the skills and capacity to address customer outcomes. Possessing the ability to translate technical concepts into business value for customers and then talk in technical depth with teams, you will cultivate strong customer, Amazon Global Sales (AGS), and ProServe team relationships which enables exceptional business performance. PADLs success is primarily measured through the Area P&L by delivering customer engagements on time, within budget, and exceeding customer expectations (CSAT).
   

  

 The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using the AWS Cloud. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Leading and managing the Area Shared Delivery Team, overseeing Delivery Practice Managers (DPMs) and their teams
* Ensuring delivery of best-in-class solutions for customers and partners, meeting and exceeding satisfaction targets
* Driving business development initiatives and provide portfolio guidance and oversight
* Collaborating with ProServe Account Executives to identify and define customer business outcomes
* Managing the Area P&L, optimizing team growth, performance, and utilization
* Serving as an escalation point for Sales and Delivery teams, engaging in pre-sales, in-flight projects, and post-implementation reviews


**About The Team**
 Diverse Experiences
   

  

 AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job below, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
   

  

 Why AWS?
   

  

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
   

  

 Inclusive Team Culture
   

  

 Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
   

  

 Mentorship & Career Growth
   

  

 We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
   

  

 Work/Life Balance
   

  

 We value work-life harmony.
   

  

 Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 10+ years of experience in IT and/or Management Consulting/Services, with at least 5 years in a senior leadership role
* Experience leading cloud transformation projects
* 
* 10+ years of experience in IT and/or Management Consulting/Services, with at least 5 years in a senior leadership role [Alternative: Experience in IT and/or Management Consulting/Services, and people leadership role]
* 
* Experience leading cloud transformation projects
* 
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, related field, or equivalent experience
* 
* Leveraging deep AWS knowledge to guide sellers in proposing optimal solutions
* 
* Monitoring and analyzing key performance indicators, ensuring accurate reporting and forecasting to optimize operational processes and manage risk


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation skills with the ability to build and maintain C-level client relationships.
* Advanced knowledge of AWS services and cloud computing trends
* Strong people management and performance management skills
* Proficiency in financial analysis, contract management, and risk management
* Ability to navigate complex stakeholder relationships and drive change
* Strategic thinking and decision-making capabilities in ambiguous environments


 Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. Protecting your privacy and the security of your data is a longstanding top priority for Amazon. Please consult our Privacy Notice (https://www.amazon.jobs/en/privacy\_page) to know more about how we collect, use and transfer the personal data of our candidates.
   

  

 Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.
   

  

  

**Company** 
 - AWS EMEA SARL (Sweden Branch)

title: Named Enterprise Account Executive
description:
SLSQ327R57
   

  

 Want to help solve the world's toughest problems with data and AI? This is what we do every day at Databricks.
   

  

 Databricks operates at the leading edge of the Data and AI space. Our customers turn to us to lead the accelerated innovation their businesses need to gain first-mover advantage in today's ultra-competitive landscape.
   

  

 We are looking for a creative, delivery-oriented Enterprise Account Executive to join the team in the Nordics to maximise the phenomenal market opportunity that exists for Databricks Sweden. As an Account Executive, you know how to sell innovation and value to existing customers, identify new use cases and grow consumption and can guide deals forward to compress decision cycles. You love understanding a product in depth and are passionate about communicating its value to customers and partners. You will be offered huge potential for career progression with the pace of the team's growth.
   

  

 You will report to the Sales Director for Sweden and Finland.
   

  

**The Impact You Will Have**
* You will co-develop a business plan, with your team and ecosystem partners, that accelerates customer success to exceed quarterly/annual consumption and booking goals
* You will lead your team, customers and partners to identify impactful data and AI use cases whilst proving out their value on the Databricks Data Intelligence platform
* You will implement the data and AI transformation goals of your customer through a combination of strategic partnerships, well scoped professional services, training and targeted Executive engagement
* You will develop an understanding of technical product details and roadmap to build trust with executives and technical champions


**What We Look For**
* Exstensive experience selling complex solutions to Enterprise Customers
* You will have experience managing and leading complex, federated sales campaigns in major accounts
* You will have experience working in Data, Cloud industries with some technical sales experience
* Proof of exceeding sales quotas in high-growth Enterprise software companies
* You will have experience driving consumption and commit-based engagement models and strategies working with professional services and training teams
* You will have experience co-selling and scaling your business with Cloud Vendors (AWS, Azure and Google Cloud teams) and Global Solution Integrators (GSI)
* Experience of building effective champions, collaborative teams and partnerships to support execution of your account / territory plan
* Understanding of how to identify all key uses cases and buying centres in an opportunity to increase the impact of Databricks in an organisation
* Experience of following robust sales methodologies and process, e.g. account planning, MEDDPICC, Value Selling and accurate forecasting
* Bachelor's Degree or relevant work experience
* Fluency in English is required


**About Databricks**
 Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn, X, YouTube, and Instagram.
   

  

**Benefits**
 At Databricks, we strive to provide comprehensive benefits and perks that meet the needs of all of our employees. For specific details on the benefits offered in your region click here.
   

  

**Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion**
 At Databricks, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive culture where everyone can excel. We take great care to ensure that our hiring practices are inclusive and meet equal employment opportunity standards. Individuals looking for employment at Databricks are considered without regard to age, color, disability, ethnicity, family or marital status, gender identity or expression, language, national origin, physical and mental ability, political affiliation, race, religion, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, veteran status, and other protected characteristics.
   

  

**Compliance**

title: Business Development Manager - Cloud
description:
**Varför Välja TD SYNNEX**
 Som ett globalt Fortune 500-företag, verksamt i över 100 länder, värdesätter TD SYNNEX sin mångsidiga arbetsstyrka på 24 000 anställda. Som världens största IT-distributör är vårt uppdrag att tillhandahålla förstklassiga teknologilösningar och ge företag och individer möjlighet att navigera i den digitala världen på ett säkert och effektivt sätt.
   

  

**Om Rollen**
 Som
 **Business Development Manager för Microsoft Azure** 
 får du en central kommersiell roll i utvecklingen av TD SYNNEX svenska Azure-affär.
   

  

 Du ansvarar för att identifiera nya affärsmöjligheter, rekrytera och aktivera partners samt hjälpa etablerade partners att utveckla och skala sin Azure-affär. Du arbetar marknadsorienterat, prioriterar insatser utifrån affärspotential och bidrar till den övergripande affärsplanen tillsammans med Microsoft, interna specialistteam och TD SYNNEX ledning.
   

  

 Rollen passar dig som har erfarenhet av partnerutveckling, kanalförsäljning eller affärsutveckling och som har en god förståelse för Azure och molnaffären. Du behöver inte vara lösningsarkitekt, men du ska kunna föra en inledande lösningsdialog, kvalificera kundens behov och involvera rätt teknisk kompetens när affären kräver det.
   

  

 En viktig del av rollen är också att identifiera hur TD SYNNEX support-, tjänste- och finansieringserbjudanden kan stärka partnerns lösning och skapa ett större affärsvärde för slutkunden.
   

  

**Vad Du Kommer Att Göra**
* Rekrytera nya återförsäljare och utveckla deras affär tillsammans med TD SYNNEX.
* Aktivera partners som ännu inte har etablerat en skalbar Azure-affär.
* Hjälpa aktiva partners att skapa tillväxt genom nya Azure-lösningar, tjänster och kommersiella paketeringar.
* Utveckla och genomföra den kommersiella planen för Microsoft Azure i Sverige.
* Prioritera partners, affärsmöjligheter och initiativ utifrån potential, lönsamhet och genomförbarhet.
* Driva utvalda strategiska affärer och stötta säljteamet i andra affärsmöjligheter.
* Föra inledande lösningsdialoger, kvalificera behov och samla rätt kommersiella och tekniska kompetenser kring affären.
* Positionera TD SYNNEX befintliga support-, tjänste- och finansieringserbjudanden som en del av partnerns lösning.
* Planera och genomföra partneraktiviteter, exempelvis webbinarier, hackathons, workshops och roadshows.
* Bygga och utveckla starka relationer med Microsoft, återförsäljare och andra viktiga intressenter.
* Följa upp kommersiella resultat, partneraktivering, pipeline och genomförda initiativ.


**Vi Tror Att Du Har**
* Minst tre års relevant erfarenhet av partnerutveckling, kanalförsäljning, affärsutveckling eller komplex B2B-försäljning inom IT.
* Erfarenhet av att arbeta med återförsäljare, partners eller andra indirekta försäljningskanaler.
* God förståelse för Microsoft Azure eller en jämförbar molnplattform.
* Förmåga att föra övergripande lösningsdiskussioner och kvalificera behov innan tekniska specialister involveras.
* Förmåga att förstå partnerns och slutkundens verksamhet och omsätta identifierade behov till relevanta kommersiella erbjudanden.
* Erfarenhet av att självständigt ta initiativ och driva aktiviteter från idé till genomförande.
* Ett affärsmässigt och strukturerat arbetssätt samt förmåga att prioritera mellan flera parallella möjligheter.
* Flytande svenska och mycket god engelska i tal och skrift.


 Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av Microsoft CSP, Azure consumption, IT-distribution, supportavtal, managed services eller professional services.
   

  

**Vem Vi Tror Att Du Är**
 Du är förtroendeingivande och trygg i dialogen med partners, kunder och interna kollegor. Du är nyfiken, affärsorienterad och har lätt för att skapa engagemang och få med dig andra.
   

  

 Du väntar inte på att någon annan ska definiera varje aktivitet. Du identifierar möjligheter, tar initiativ och anpassar planen när marknaden eller partnernas behov förändras. Samtidigt har du gott omdöme och förstår när en affär kräver teknisk specialistkompetens. Du är då skicklig på att samla rätt personer och driva arbetet framåt.
   

  

 Du behöver inte kunna allt från början. Däremot har du ambitionen, nyfikenheten och lärförmågan som krävs för att snabbt utveckla din kompetens och successivt ta ett större ansvar för Azure-affären.
   

  

 At TD SYNNEX, our values guide everything we do: Together, We Own It, We Dare to Go, We Grow and Win, and above all, We Do the Right Thing. These principles shape how we work with each other, our partners, and our communities as we drive innovation and create lasting impact.
   

  

**What's In It For You?**
* Elective Benefits: Our programs are tailored to your country to best accommodate your lifestyle.
* Grow Your Career: Accelerate your path to success (and keep up with the future) with formal programs on leadership and professional development, and many more on-demand courses.
* Elevate Your Personal Well-Being: Boost your financial, physical, and mental well-being through seminars, events, and our global Life Empowerment Assistance Program.
* Diversity, Equity & Inclusion: It's not just a phrase to us; valuing every voice is how we succeed. Join us in celebrating our global diversity through inclusive education, meaningful peer-to-peer conversations, and equitable growth and development opportunities.
* Make the Most of our Global Organization: Network with other new co-workers within your first 30 days through our onboarding program.
* Connect with Your Community: Participate in internal, peer-led inclusive communities and activities, including business resource groups, local volunteering events, and more environmental and social initiatives.


**Don't meet every single requirement? Apply anyway.**
 At TD SYNNEX, we're proud to be recognized as a great place to work and a leader in the promotion and practice of diversity, equity and inclusion. If you're excited about working for our company and believe you're a good fit for this role, we encourage you to apply. You may be exactly the person we're looking for!

title: Experienced Project Manager
description:
**Welcome to Eficode!**
 At Eficode, we are building the future of software development. As an Atlassian Platinum Partner (multiple-time Partner of the Year), two-time GitHub Partner of the Year (EMEA), and Azure Managed Service Provider, we empower organizations across Cloud, DevOps, Agile, and AI-powered transformations. With 600 experts across 10 countries, we bring together top-tier talent to help enterprises deliver faster, smarter, and more sustainably.
   

  

 We are looking for two experienced Senior Project Managers to join our Global Delivery Office. You won't just run projects - you will actively help shape, build, and standardize our global PM practices across Eficode as we centralize our delivery framework. You'll work closely with our technical teams, Segment Leads and Sales, as well as senior stakeholders on the customer side.
   

  

****What you'll do****
* Drive high-impact deliveries: Lead complex, multi-country customer projects - including cloud migrations and large DevOps transformations.
* End-to-end ownership: Take full accountability for project scope, schedules, budgets, profitability, risks, and change management.
* Senior stakeholder management: Lead customer steering groups, align expectations, and handle complex escalations or difficult project situations with clarity and composure.
* Commercial strategy: Partner with Sales on complex opportunities - assessing scoping, estimates, delivery risks, and converting challenges into customer opportunities.
* Cross-functional leadership: Coordinate multi-disciplinary technical teams and consultants across borders without needing line-management authority.
* Mentor and elevate: Share expertise with other PMs while refining common delivery standards.


**Who you are:**
* Proven track record: 5+ years managing complex, customer-facing B2B IT projects within consulting or IT professional services environments.
* Technical & domain expertise: Experience delivering large-scale digital transformations, cloud migrations, DevOps programs, or complex system integrations.
* Strong business acumen: In-depth understanding of project finances (margins, forecasting, change control) paired with a commercial mindset.
* Cross-border collaborator: Track record leading cross-country teams and multi-stakeholder international engagements.
* Atlassian power user: Hands-on proficiency using the Atlassian stack (Jira & Confluence) as primary project management tools.
* Clear & decisive communicator: We value people who communicate clearly, ask questions when something doesn't make sense, and don't wait until a problem becomes critical before raising it. You have the confidence to manage complex situations and align expectations early and transparently.
* Language: Fluent in English.


**Nice to have:**
* Project Management certifications such as PMP, PRINCE2 or equivalent.
* Experience developing Project Management processes or standards in a consulting or professional services organization.


**What’s in it for you?**
* Join a community of bright minds: Work alongside passionate, supportive colleagues in an international scale-up where your expertise is trusted and your voice is heard.
* Flexibility and autonomy: Enjoy flexible working hours and a hybrid work setup that gives you the autonomy to structure your work-life balance.
* Continuous growth: Expand your skills through internal knowledge-sharing sessions, company-supported external training courses, and more.
* Competitive local benefits and well-being initiatives.


 To learn more about working at Eficode and our recruitment process, check our career website.
   

  

 Ready to build with us? Submit your CV to apply. We're looking forward to reading from you!

title: DevOps Engineer till verksamhetskritisk IT-miljö
description:
*Vill du ta ditt konsultande till nästa nivå hos Sveriges bästa arbetsgivare? Vi vet vad du tänker. Du har hört det förut. Men tro oss, det har du inte. Vårt körsbär på konsulttårtan är något annat. Sök jobbet och smaka själv!*
 DevOps Engineer till verksamhetskritisk IT-miljö
   

  

 Vi söker nu en erfaren
 **DevOps Engineer** 
 till ett uppdrag inom en verksamhetskritisk IT-miljö kopplad till kraftsystemanalys, driftplanering och långsiktig utveckling.
   

  

 Du kommer att arbeta i en sektion som levererar IT-system och applikationer som möjliggör analys och utveckling.. Miljön är komplex, säkerhetskritisk och under stark tillväxt, med både egenutvecklade och inköpta system. Rollen passar dig som är trygg i tekniskt avancerade miljöer och vill bidra till ökad automatisering, stabilitet och effektivitet genom DevOps-arbetssätt.
   

  

**Om rollen**
 Som DevOps Engineer kommer du att arbeta nära utvecklingsteam, plattforms- och infrastrukturteam samt externa leverantörer. Du blir en viktig del i att förbättra arbetssätt, automatisera flöden och säkerställa stabila och säkra driftsmiljöer.
   

  

 Dina arbetsuppgifter kommer bland annat att omfatta:
   

  

* Automatisering av konfigurationshantering och installationer
* Driftsättning, paketering och konfigurering av applikationer
* Optimering av miljöer i Windows, Linux och Kubernetes
* Övervakning, loggning, incidentanalys och förbättring av stabilitet
* Byggande och vidareutveckling av CI/CD-pipelines
* Samarbete med utvecklingsteam, infrastrukturteam och leverantörer
* Dokumentation och kompetensspridning inom teamet
* Stöd till system- och applikationsansvariga vid exempelvis beställningar, säkerhetsrelaterade uppgifter och koordinering


**Vi söker dig som har**
* Minst 10+ års erfarenhet i tekniktunga IT-roller, exempelvis som DevOps Engineer, systemadministratör, infrastrukturtekniker, systemutvecklare eller IT-arkitekt alternativt minst 10 års relevant erfarenhet samt relevant högskole-/universitetsutbildning
* Minst 5 års erfarenhet som DevOps Engineer i agila team
* Minst 3 års erfarenhet av konfiguration, driftsättning och felsökning i Windowsmiljö
* Minst 3 års erfarenhet av konfiguration, driftsättning och felsökning i Linuxmiljö
* Minst 5 års erfarenhet av skriptprogrammering, exempelvis Bash, PowerShell eller Python
* Minst 3 års erfarenhet av containers och Kubernetes
* Minst 5 års erfarenhet av monitorering, observerbarhet och logghantering, exempelvis OP5, Loki, Grafana eller Prometheus
* Minst 5 års erfarenhet av automatiserad konfiguration, exempelvis Ansible, Terraform eller Helm
* Minst 5 års erfarenhet av CI/CD-verktyg såsom Azure DevOps, GitLab, Argo CD, Artifactory, JFrog Xray, SonarQube eller Git
* Mycket god förmåga att kommunicera obehindrat på svenska och engelska i både tal och skrift


**Meriterande**
 Det är meriterande om du har:
   

  

* Minst 3 års erfarenhet av systemutveckling eller testautomatisering i C++, C# eller Python
* Minst 3 års erfarenhet från IT-miljöer med mycket höga säkerhetskrav


**Övrigt**
 Uppdraget omfattas av säkerhetsprövning och registerkontroll. Uppdragsstart kan därför ske först efter att säkerhetsprövning och registerkontroll är genomförd och godkänd.
   

  

**Bara det bästa åt de bästa – vår personalfilosofi**
 Castra är en konsultgrupp inom IT och Management. Eller ja, en elite squad kan man säga. Vi samlar de vassaste och mest erfarna konsulterna, helt enkelt för att det är hos oss de får ut max i både kapacitet och livskvalitet. Vi är verksamma inom Systemutveckling, IT-infrastruktur, IT-styrning & Ledarskap samt IT-säkerhet.
   

  

 Vi är utsedda till Sveriges- och Europas bästa arbetsplats, på riktigt! Det låter lite skrytsamt, men det är faktiskt inte vi som sagt det. Castra har sedan 2017 blivit certifierad av
 **Great Place to Work,** 
 en utmärkelse som är helt baserat på medarbetarundersökningar. Vi har de senaste tre åren blivit utnämnda till
 **Sveriges Bästa Arbetsplats** 
 för stora bolag och nu senast kammade vi även hem förstaplatsen bland
 **Europas Bästa Arbetsplatser** 
 . Som grädde på moset är vi även ett Gasell- och Karriärföretag!
   

  

 På Castra tror vi på frihet, utveckling och gemenskap. Du som konsult styr själv vilka uppdrag du tar, när du jobbar, om du vill levla upp någon kompetens och hur och mycket lön och semester du tar ut. Att du får bygga din egen logga är bara en bonus! Trodde du det var allt? Då trodde du fel.
