title: Senior SAP Solution Architect – EAM, Logistics & Digital Platforms
description:
**Shape the Future of Enterprise Solutions**
 As
 **Senior SAP Solution Architect** 
 – EAM, Logistics & Digital Platforms, you will design and optimize complex SAP landscapes that power Vattenfall’s operations across multiple countries. This role calls for broad, all-round technology skills and the ability to connect business needs with advanced IT solutions—while acting as a trusted advisor and consultant to our internal business teams.
   

  

**Why this role matters**
 We are transforming into a data-driven organization to support our mission. Your work will enable smarter decisions, predictive maintenance, and seamless integration across SAP and related platforms. You’ll help us build secure, scalable solutions that keep our operations running smoothly—and guide our business stakeholders in making technology choices that deliver real value.
   

  

**You’ll Work On**
* Enterprise Asset Management (EAM/PM) and Logistics processes (S2C, P2P) on SAP S/4HANA
* ePPM for project and portfolio management
* Document Management Systems (DMS) and Work Clearance Management (WCM)
* Integration strategies for hybrid SAP landscapes (cloud and on-premise)
* Supporting financial processes with a general understanding of CO Controlling


 Your responsibilities
   

  

* Guide strategic projects with fit-for-purpose architecture
* Act as an internal consultant: advise business stakeholders on SAP strategy, integration, and data architecture
* Ensure IT security compliance and support adoption of IEC 62443, ISO27001 standards
* Develop architecture principles and standards for enterprise-wide solutions
* Be a trusted advisor to enable operating models through technology


**Location**
 Stockholm
   

  

**Qualifications**
**Who are you?**
 You combine technical depth with business insight and thrive in complex environments. Ideally, you bring:
   

  

* Academic degree in IT or related field
* Hands-on experience as SAP Solution Architect in asset-intensive industries (energy, utilities, manufacturing)
* Strong knowledge of SAP S/4HANA, EAM (PM), ePPM, Logistics (S2C, P2P), DMS, WCM
* General understanding of CO Controlling
* Familiarity with Microsoft Azure Well-Architected Framework
* Experience with security frameworks and critical infrastructure requirements
* Fluent in Swedish and English


 Additional Information
   

  

**Our offer**
 Good remuneration, a challenging and international work environment, and the possibility to work with some of the best in the field. You will be working in interdisciplinary teams and you can always count on support from committed colleagues. We offer attractive employment conditions and opportunities for personal and professional development.
   

  

 For more information about the recruitment process you are welcome to contact our
 **Senior Recruiter Marius Gläßge via marius.glaessge@vattenfall.de** 
 .
   

  

 Trade union representatives in Sweden: Anders Bohlin (Unionen), Juha Siipilehto (SEKO), Christer Gustafsson (Ledarna) and Marika Westman (Akademikerna). To get in contact with the representatives, please call Vattenfall´s switchboard +46 8 739 50 00.
   

  

**We welcome your application in English no later than 26th October 2026** 
 . We kindly request that you do not send applications by any means other than via our website and that you refrain from submitting a cover letter with your application. You apply quickly and easily by answering screening questions and attaching your CV.
   

  

 At Vattenfall, we value being active, positive, open, and safety-conscious. We are looking for employees who share our vision and can contribute to strengthening our corporate culture. We firmly believe that diversity helps build a more profitable and attractive company, and we strive to be good role models when it comes to diversity. Vattenfall actively works to ensure that all employees have the same opportunities and rights regardless of age, ethnic or cultural background, gender identity, religion/belief, sexual orientation, or disability. Read more about how we work with diversity and inclusion here.
   

  

 The security of Vattenfall and its employees is essential. For that reason, a pre-employment screening will be part of your recruitment process. The screening is based on the role you will fulfill within Vattenfall.
   

  

*Working at Vattenfall means working with critical societal infrastructure. Therefore, many of our positions are security-classified, and you may be required to fill a wartime posting. If this position is security-classified, a security clearance will be carried out before employment, in accordance with the Security Protection Act. Any potential wartime posting will be based on the employment contract and the Total Defence Service Act.*
 We look forward to receiving your application!
   

  

**Company Description**
 Vattenfall is one of Europe’s largest producers and retailers of electricity and heat. Our main markets are Sweden, Germany, the Netherlands, Denmark, and the UK. The Vattenfall Group has approximately 21 000 employees. We have been electrifying industries, powering homes and transforming life through innovation for more than 100 years.

title: Senior Platform Architect
description:
**Company Description**
 It all started in sunny San Diego, California in 2004 when a visionary engineer, Fred Luddy, saw the potential to transform how we work. Fast forward to today — ServiceNow stands as a global market leader, bringing innovative AI-enhanced technology to over 8,100 customers, including 85% of the Fortune 500®. Our intelligent cloud-based platform seamlessly connects people, systems, and processes to empower organizations to find smarter, faster, and better ways to work. But this is just the beginning of our journey. Join us as we pursue our purpose to make the world work better for everyone.
   

  

**Job Description**
 The Customer Success
 **Senior** 
**Platform Architect** 
 is an advisory role, responsible for helping our customers establish a technical foundation in the ServiceNow Platform and design solutions that deliver outcomes. The Senior Platform Architect ensures customers use leading practices around instance strategy, technical governance, core data, integrations and the health of the platform. This is a consultative role focused on guiding ServiceNow, partner and customer employees on the engagement team to provide a solution on an architecture designed for long-term success.
   

  

* You will work with the customer across executive, platform owner, enterprise architects, and development teams during the selling, structuring, and implementation of solutions.
* Be an architectural advisor across multiple engagements to guide customers, partners, and internal team members to provide successful customer solutions.
* Provide a variety of architectural knowledge across multiple workflows.
* Develop relationships with CoEI and business leaders at the customer site to understand the role of ServiceNow in their digital transformation vision.
* Translate goals to outcomes into a customer roadmap.
* Translate business information and technical requirements into an architectural blueprint to achieve complex goals.
* Engage with the customer's Enterprise Architects to position ServiceNow as the digital transformation platform standard, integrated with the customer's core applications.
* Manage technical governance, and a delivery operating model and governance.
* Ensure instance health by working with the engagement team to reduce technical debt and align to ServiceNow leading practices.
* Support the sales effort by scoping and estimating the engagement and change orders.
* Be an active contributor of leading practices and expertise related to the ServiceNow platform.


**Qualifications**
**To be successful in this role you have:**
* Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analysing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI’s potential impact on the function or industry.
* 8+ years progressive experience as part of a professional services (SaaS) organization; or equivalent education/experience
* Management consulting experience
* Success driving complex issues through analysis and resolution
* Industry domain expertise
* Large program experience leading architecture and design
* Enterprise architecture experience
* Cloud application technology experience
* Right to work in country
* Fluent in Swedish/Norwegian and English


 Additional Information
   

  

**Work Personas**
 We approach our distributed world of work with flexibility and trust. Work personas (flexible, remote, or required in office) are categories that are assigned to ServiceNow employees depending on the nature of their work. Learn more here.

 ServiceNow is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin or nationality, ancestry, age, disability, gender identity or expression, marital status, veteran status, or any other category protected by law. In addition, all qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with legal requirements.
   

  

**Accommodations**
 We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, or are unable to use this online application and need an alternative method to apply, please contact talent.acquisition@servicenow.com for assistance.

 For positions requiring access to controlled technology subject to export control regulations, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR), ServiceNow may be required to obtain export control approval from government authorities for certain individuals. title: Produktägare
description:
Vill du vara med och bygga moderna tekniska plattformar för samhällsviktig infrastruktur?
   

  

 Hos E-hälsomyndigheten får du arbeta med nationella e-hälsotjänster som bidrar till en trygg läkemedelshantering och gör det enklare för apotek, vården och medborgare att få tillgång till kritisk information i rätt tid. Drivs du av att säkerställa att det som byggs skapar verkligt värde för användare och verksamhet? Då kan det här vara rollen för dig!
   

  

**Om tjänsten**
 I rollen som agil produktägare inom IT-området ingår du i ett tvärfunktionellt utvecklingsteam där du har ett övergripande ansvar för teamets backlogg, prioriteringar och riktningen framåt. Du arbetar nära andra agila produktägare och ledande roller för att säkerställa hög leveransförmåga och att vi arbetar mot gemensamma mål.
   

  

 Teamets ansvar ligger i att utveckla och förvalta IT-komponenter i den gemensamma plattformen som ska kunna användas i verksamhetens tjänsteutveckling. För närvarande sker utveckling av t ex AI-gateway, automatiserade certifikathantering, Digital Post samt Renovate-AI.
   

  

 Du ansvarar för att teamet arbetar med rätt saker vid rätt tidpunkt, samtidigt som du kontinuerligt kommunicerar med produkternas användare för att fånga behov och omsätta dem till värdeskapande utveckling. Du får även möjlighet att samordna arbetet med både interna och externa intressenter och driver flera initiativ parallellt i en komplex miljö med många beroenden.
   

  

 Du tillhör enheten produktledning som omfattar ledande roller i vår agila organisation såsom SAFe-ramverkets roller (PM, RTE, PO samt SA). Utöver detta finns domän- och lösningsarkitekter som kommer vara nära samarbetspartners för att lösa tågens behov.
   

  

 Enheten tillhör sektionen Utveckling av plattformar, som ansvarar för att utveckla och ta fram gemensamma IT-komponenter som delas mellan verksamhetsområden och övriga avdelningar. Fokus är bl a att leverera tjänster genom självbetjäning och att kunna få fullständiga CI/CD-flöden för verksamhetens produkter.
   

  

 Vi ingår i avdelningen Digital strategi och plattform som består av medarbetare som utöver vår sektion arbetar inom områdena applikationsdrift och -support, digital arbetsplats, digital strategi, portfölj och utredning.
   

  

 Avdelningen ansvarar för myndighetens IT-styrning, arkitektur, utvecklingsmetodik och ramverk såsom t ex vårt agila arbetssätt. Vi ansvarar också för att tillhandahålla, förvalta och utveckla IT-drift och -support, återanvändningsbara IT-komponenter och tekniska gemensamma plattformar för myndigheten.
   

  

**Om dig**
 Vi söker dig som rör dig mellan olika perspektiv med förmågan att se helheten. Du är en person som får saker att hända genom att aktivt driva arbetet framåt. Du trivs i dialogen mellan olika kompetenser och skapar förutsättningar som möjliggör gemensam leverans. Du skapar goda relationer och framdrift tillsammans med andra. Vidare ser du möjligheter i nya arbetssätt och vågar prova nya vägar. Du omsätter idéer till handling och utmanar, testar och justerar som en naturlig del av att skapa värde. Som ledare skapar du engagemang och delaktighet i teamen.
   

  

**Vi söker dig som har:**
* akademisk examen inom data/IT/systemvetenskap eller motsvarande flerårig likvärdig arbetslivserfarenhet
* flerårig aktuell erfarenhet som produktägare (PO), teknisk projektledare eller liknande roll i komplexa IT-miljöer, med prioritering utifrån värde, användarbehov och effekt
* flerårig erfarenhet av att arbeta i och leda agila utvecklingsteam, exempelvis av ramverket SAFe
* minst fem års teknisk erfarenhet av arbete inom IT- eller plattformsorganisationer med ansvar för gemensamma utvecklingsverktyg/miljöer, tekniska plattformar och gemensamma IT-komponenter
* mycket god förmåga att uttrycka dig väl i tal och skrift på svenska och engelska.


**Det är meriterande för tjänsten om du har:**
* erfarenhet från hälso- och sjukvårdssektorn eller annan reglerad verksamhet
* erfarenhet av IT- och informationssäkerhet samt regelefterlevnad inom offentlig sektor
* erfarenhet av agila arbetssätt i medelstora till stora organisationer
* erfarenhet av att driva, prioritera och införa AI-förmågor, verktygsstöd, tjänster och plattformar inom IT-verksamhet och utvecklingsteam.


**Vad erbjuder vi?**
 E-hälsomyndigheten är en myndighet i tillväxt och vi driver utvecklingen av nationell digital infrastruktur inom hälsa, vård och omsorg. Vi skapar förutsättningar för digitala tjänster och lösningar för både privatpersoner och professioner inom hälso- och sjukvård, apotek och socialtjänst. Vi arbetar för att hälsodata ska bli tillgängliga i hela vårdkedjan.
   

  

 Vi är cirka 700 medarbetare i Kalmar och Stockholm. Hos oss finns möjlighet att göra skillnad i en innovativ miljö med trevliga och kompetenta arbetskamrater. Alla medarbetare har förtroendearbetstid och kan arbeta delvis på distans. Läs mer om E-hälsomyndigheten som arbetsplats: Jobba hos oss
   

  

**Är du intresserad?**
 Frågor angående tjänsten besvaras av:
   

  

 Rekryterande chef Kristina Lundh Tormod: Direktnummer: 010-175 64 04
   

  

 Frågor angående rekryteringsprocessen besvaras av:
   

  

 HR-specialist Elisabeth Axelsson: 010-106 08 98
   

  

 Välkommen att skicka in din ansökan och cv via vårt rekryteringsverktyg senast den
 **5 november 2026** 
 . Ladda gärna upp examensbevis, betyg och intyg som är relevanta för tjänsten i samband med din ansökan.
   

  

 Anställningen är tillsvidare med sex månaders provanställning. Tillträde snarast eller enligt överenskommelse. Placeringsort för anställningen är Stockholm eller Kalmar. Arbetet kan innebära tjänsteresor, främst mellan de båda orterna.
   

  

 En anställning hos oss kan innebära placering i säkerhetsklass. Därför kan vi komma att behöva genomföra en säkerhetsprövning med registerkontroll enligt säkerhetsskyddslagen (2018:585). För en del arbetsuppgifter i säkerhetsklass krävs svenskt medborgarskap.
   

  

 Om du har beslut om skyddade personuppgifter, kontakta den HR-specialist som finns namngiven i annonsen.
   

  

 Läs mer om oss på www.ehalsomyndigheten.se

title: Commercial Account Executive, Acquisition | Remote | Sweden
description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.
   

  

 We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.
   

  

 You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.
   

  

 The Opportunity
   

  

 Grafana Labs is looking for a
 **Commercial Account Executive, Acquisition** 
 based in Sweden who will be responsible for prospecting and closing new business across the
 **Nordics** 
 . You will identify, nurture and close opportunities with new customers, manage forecasts and track customer data. We're strong proponents of a consultative sales approach - learn about the customer's needs first before talking products. Your expertise will be critical in helping articulate the value of our products, work with the customer during the trial phase and hand off a strong relationship to our Growth team. Ideally, you come from a technical background and have sold technical products before.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Doing**
* Meet and exceed individual quarterly and annual sales goals
* Outbound prospecting into net-new customers
* Manage all aspects of the sales process (prospecting, sales meetings, product demos, proofs of concept, proposals, and negotiations)
* Cultivate sales through outbound prospecting and inbound leads
* Be able to understand and convey the value of both Grafana Cloud and Grafana Enterprise
* Become an expert in managing your sales pipeline in Salesforce
* Manage quote creation, order processing, and day-to-day customer requests


**What Makes You a Great Fit**
* 2+ Years of experience in infrastructure technology sales
* Demonstrated history of consistent goal achievement in a highly competitive environment (top 10% performer)
* Energetic, upbeat, entrepreneurial, tenacious team player
* Adaptable and with demonstrable experience in high velocity technology companies
* You will need to be an excellent communicator in all channels (in person, online, in writing) and able to form strong working relationships both in person and virtually
* Fluent in English & Swedish or Danish or Norwegian or Finnish.


**Bonus Points For**
* Familiarity with open source technology is a significant advantage
* Experience using Salesforce
* Experience using Command of the Message and MEDD(P)ICC is ideal


 Compensation & Rewards
   

  

 In Sweden, the OTE compensation range for this role is SEK 1,400,000 - SEK 1,800,000. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.
   

  

* Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.


**Why You’ll Thrive At Grafana Labs**
* 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
* Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
* Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
* Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
* Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
* Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
* Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
* Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
* Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
* In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.
* Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. \*We will comply with local legislation where applicable.


**Equal Opportunity Employer:** 
*Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.*

 We're looking for an AI-focused technologist who wants to do more than experiment with new tools and build proofs of concept. This is an opportunity to help shape how AI is used across a large, people-focused organisation, identifying valuable opportunities, developing practical solutions and taking them through to implementation.
 



  





 The organisation is investing in its digitalisation agenda and has already identified a range of potential AI use cases across its operations. The next step is to turn those ideas into working solutions that deliver measurable value.
 



  





 You'll work closely with business stakeholders, data and technology teams to understand operational challenges, explore what AI can realistically achieve and lead the development and implementation of solutions. You'll have the freedom to experiment, test ideas and help establish the direction for AI going forward, while remaining close to the technical delivery yourself.
 



  





**The role:** 




 This is a broad, hands-on role sitting at the intersection of AI, data, technology and business development. You'll help bridge the gap between identifying an opportunity and delivering a solution that people can actually use.
 



  





 Your responsibilities will include:
 


* Identify and prioritise AI opportunities by working with business stakeholders to understand their challenges, explore potential use cases and assess where AI and automation can make a meaningful difference.
* Take AI initiatives from idea to implementation, leading discovery, prototyping, development and deployment, rather than leaving projects at the proof-of-concept stage.
* Shape the AI roadmap and strategy, helping the organisation decide which opportunities to pursue, how to prioritise them and what technical approach makes the most sense.
* Build and experiment with AI solutions, working hands-on with modern AI tools, LLMs, APIs and relevant data technologies to develop and validate practical solutions.
* Connect business needs with technical delivery, translating operational requirements into clear technical approaches and working closely with developers and other technology specialists to bring solutions to life.
* Evaluate and improve existing pilots, testing what works, measuring outcomes and identifying opportunities to scale successful solutions across different parts of the organisation.
* Support adoption and continuous improvement, ensuring solutions are useful, reliable and integrated into real workflows, with appropriate consideration for data quality, security and responsible AI use.



  





**What we're looking for:** 




 We're interested in someone who combines a solid technical foundation with commercial awareness and the ability to work directly with the business.
 



  





 You don't need to be a long-established AI executive or a career strategist. We're looking for someone who understands the technology, enjoys building things and can take ownership of moving AI initiatives forward.
 



  





 You'll ideally bring:
 


* Experience in AI engineering, applied AI, data engineering, software development or a closely related technical field.
* Practical experience building AI-powered applications, automations, prototypes or other solutions using modern AI technologies.
* An understanding of large language models (LLMs), AI APIs and how to apply them to real business problems.
* Strong data fundamentals and an appreciation of how data quality, structure and accessibility affect the success of AI solutions.
* The ability to assess a business problem, identify a potential technical solution and work out how to deliver it in practice.
* An interest in AI strategy and technical decision-making, including evaluating tools, platforms and approaches and helping establish a roadmap.
* A proactive, hands-on mindset and the confidence to take an idea forward without needing every step defined in advance.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate with both technical colleagues and non-technical stakeholders.



  





 Experience taking AI solutions beyond experimentation and into production would be particularly valuable. Familiarity with cloud-based AI services, Microsoft technologies, Python, AI agents, RAG or workflow automation would also be beneficial.
 



  





 We're open to different backgrounds. You might be an AI Engineer with a strong interest in product and business problems, a Data Engineer who has moved into applied AI, or a Software Engineer who enjoys exploring how AI can solve operational challenges.
 



  





**Why join?** 



* Build something from the ground up. Help establish how AI is developed and implemented across the organisation, with plenty of scope to explore new approaches.
* Influence the direction of AI. Have a genuine voice in identifying opportunities, prioritising initiatives and shaping the technical roadmap.
* Stay close to the technology. Combine strategic input with practical experimentation, development and implementation.
* Work on real-world challenges. Apply AI to operational processes and business problems where successful solutions can make a tangible difference.
* Collaborate across the organisation. Work with business development, analytics and technology colleagues to turn ideas into solutions that can be adopted and scaled.



  





 The details
 


* **Location:** 
 Stockholm, Sweden
* **Working model:** 
 Hybrid, with flexibility around remote working
* **Employment:** 
 Permanent position



  





 If you're interested in building practical AI solutions while helping shape the direction of AI within an organisation, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Application Consultant Trainee
description:

 As an Application Consultant at Lime, you turn customer problems into working solutions, and code is one of your most important tools for getting there. If the answer is yes, then this is the job for you!
 



  





**Building the future for our customers** 




 Lime CRM is a platform with infinite possibilities to customize according to the needs and ways of working of our end users. Your job involves everything from installation, adaptation and development of additional services connected to our CRM system.
 



  





 You have a solid technical understanding and enjoy building things, but what drives you is seeing technology create value for the customer. You're just as comfortable in a workshop with a customer as you are in the code. This is a journey where you will develop along the way!
 



  





 One day you're building the customer's solution in SQL, Python or TypeScript. The next you're sitting down with a customer to define the scope of a new project. The day after, you're in a workshop helping them work through a business problem and find the right way forward.
 



  





**An Application Consultant at Lime** 




 • Advises customers on how to solve their problems and how Lime CRM can support their way of working.
 



 • Interested in using AI in their own work and advising customers on how they can get real value from it.
 



 • Develops front-end components, automatic triggers and integrations with third-party systems in languages like Python, SQL and TypeScript.
 



 • Reviews and tests code, both your own and your colleagues', and takes responsibility for the quality of what we deliver.
 



 • Defines scope and sets clear frames and expectations together with the customer.
 



 • Combines deep technical understanding with the ability to work with and lead people.
 



 • Has full professional proficiency in English and the local language of where you wish to work.
 



 • Has a relevant bachelor's or master's degree within IT, Engineering, Information Systems, or equivalent.

title: Sales Director, CRM Solutions
description:
**Company Description**
 It all started in sunny San Diego, California in 2004 when a visionary engineer, Fred Luddy, saw the potential to transform how we work. Fast forward to today — ServiceNow stands as a global market leader, bringing innovative AI-enhanced technology to over 8,100 customers, including 85% of the Fortune 500®. But this is just the beginning of our journey. Join us as we pursue our purpose to make the world work better for everyone.
   

  

**Job Description**
 The Director, CRM Sales is responsible for leading a rapid expansion of ServiceNow’s CRM focused product lines in the Central region. This will be achieved through building, leading, mentoring, coaching and developing the team of Sales Executives across ServiceNow’s evolving product portfolio. As a Director, CRM Sales you will lead transformational shifts to create business value for our customers. **What You Get To Do In This Role**

title: VP, Global Engineering
description:
**About Acast**
 Since 2014, Acast has been building the world’s most valuable podcast marketplace, creating the technology that connects podcast creators, advertisers, and listeners. Its marketplace spans more than 140,000 podcasts, 3,300 advertisers, and one billion quarterly listens. Crucially, those listens are monetized wherever they happen—across any podcast app or listening platform.
   

  

**The role**
 The VP, Global Engineering leads the engineering organisation that builds and runs Acast's platforms. You turn product and technology strategy into reliable software, shipped at pace, by teams who are proud of their work and want to stay.
   

  

 This is a growth mandate, not a turnaround. The platforms work. Your job is to push them further and faster, and to build the engineering culture and operating model that makes that sustainable.
   

  

**What Success Looks Like**
* Engineering is a trusted partner to product, content and sales, not a service function.
* Teams ship high-quality software frequently and predictably.
* Platforms are scalable, secure and future-ready, with legacy systems retired and technical debt under control.
* Engineers use AI and modern tooling to work faster and better.
* Engineering is a place where strong people want to build their careers.
* Distributed teams, in-house and near-shore, work as one organisation.


**Responsibilities**
*Engineering strategy and delivery*
* Own the engineering strategy and plan, tied directly to Acast's commercial objectives.
* Improve the speed, predictability and transparency of delivery through clear planning, prioritisation and dependency management.
* Establish and hold the engineering metrics: cycle time, delivery predictability, MTTR, test coverage and release readiness.
* Set governance for architecture, scalability and technical debt, making the trade-off between near-term delivery and long-term platform health explicit enough to be argued commercially.
* Communicate technical risk, trade-offs and investment needs clearly to the leadership team and, where relevant, the Board.
* Champion agile ways of working and keep improving how teams plan, build, test and ship.


*Platform, ad serving and scale*
* Own the engineering of the systems that carry the marketplace: hosting and distribution, real-time and dynamic ad insertion, the auction and yield layer, the data platform behind targeting and measurement, and the creator and advertiser self-serve products.
* Be accountable for reliability and performance on platforms that need 24/7 uptime.
* Treat infrastructure cost per impression as an engineering metric, and manage the unit economics of serving accordingly.
* Retire legacy systems, reduce technical debt and modernise infrastructure.
* Build the platform capability to extend into video and adjacent channels without forking the stack.
* Partner with data and security on governance, privacy and the controls a listed business requires.


*Organisational leadership*
* Lead, develop and structure a distributed engineering organisation across several countries.
* Own the engineering workforce plan and budget, and manage spend against commercial outcomes.
* Evolve the management layer and develop the senior engineers and managers already in place.
* Recruit selectively where there are real capability gaps, and hold a high bar on quality, pace and accountability.
* Establish clear levelling, career paths, performance management and succession, working with the People team.
* Set the standard for how engineers work together: ownership, craft, openness and care for each other.


*Partnership with product and commercial teams*
* Act as the senior engineering partner to product leadership, jointly shaping priorities, scope, sequencing and delivery approach.
* Make sure technical constraints and opportunities reach the roadmap early.
* Build working relationships with commercial and sales so engineering understands advertiser and creator outcomes directly, and can be held to them.
* Support enterprise advertiser conversations, technical diligence and partner integrations where senior engineering credibility is needed.
* Support technical due diligence and post-merger integration of acquired engineering teams and platforms.


*AI and emerging technology*
* Own engineering's use of AI, both in how the team works and in what the platform does.
* Deploy AI-assisted tooling and automation to lift developer velocity and code quality, with appropriate governance.
* Assess where AI creates real advantage in ad decisioning, contextual targeting, measurement and creator tooling, and where it doesn't, and make the investment case accordingly.


**Experience And Background**
* Significant experience leading a large engineering organisation as a manager of managers, at a company of comparable or greater scale.
* A track record of improving delivery performance, engineering quality and operating rhythm in an organisation that had outgrown its structure, not only one that was already mature.
* Strong platform and infrastructure depth: high-volume distributed systems, real-time processing, and the reliability and cost discipline that come with serving at scale.
* Experience in marketplaces, streaming or another two-sided platform where the technology carries the revenue model. Direct dynamic ad insertion or auction experience is a clear advantage, not a requirement.
* Demonstrated success building management capability, developing senior engineering leaders and strengthening succession.
* Experience leading distributed teams across locations, cultures and time zones, in-house and near-shore.
* Experience with platform modernisation, legacy replacement and M&A integration.
* Enough technical depth to engage credibly with a complex, multi-platform environment and make pragmatic architectural calls, without needing to be a hands-on architect.
* Proven ability to partner with product leadership as an equal and work closely with commercial teams.
* Clear communication with technical, commercial and executive audiences, and the composure to operate in a listed company where performance is public.


**Skills And Attributes**
* A people-first, high-EQ leader who builds culture as well as capability.
* Strategic and commercially driven, able to connect engineering decisions to revenue and profitability.
* Presence and credibility at executive level, with the ability to influence across the organisation.
* Customer-obsessed, with a deep appreciation for the needs of creators, advertisers and audiences.
* A data-led decision maker who balances insight, intuition and speed.
* Comfortable with complexity and ambiguity in a global, fast-scaling organisation.
* Hands-on mindset, able to move between detail and vision.
* Resilient, curious, and willing to take a position.


*Leadership Attributes*
* Consistently embodies the Acast values
* Customer-obsessed and outcomes-driven.
* Strategically rigorous with a pragmatic execution mindset.
* Comfortable making trade-offs between speed, quality, and long-term investment.
* Direct, transparent communicator who builds trust across functions.
* Resilient leader who thrive in an ever-changing environment


**Location:** 
 London (UK) or Stockholm (Sweden)
   

  

 Our engineering organisation is remote-first globally, but this role works closely with key cross-functional teams and stakeholders, so regular face-to-face collaboration matters. You will be based in the UK or Sweden and work from our London or Stockholm office on a regular basis.
   

  

**Culture**
 Acast is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of race, gender, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, national origin or any of the other wonderful characteristics that make us different.
   

  

 Culture is our number one priority as a business. We believe people come first, and we work every day to enable autonomy, continuous improvement and bring out the best in people. We’re global and have remote teams, so it’s even more important that we strive for an open, inclusive and caring environment where everyone feels visible and welcome.
   

  

 We consider ourselves a modern organization driven by strong values to create the best, most fulfilling and nurturing culture.
   

  

 We very much look forward to finding the next great person to join our cause!

**Lite mer om oss på Softhouse! 🏡**

title: PhD student in Atmospheric Sciences and Oceanography, focus on ML-methods in climate modelling
description:
Some features of our web site require JavaScript to function properly. Please enable JavaScript in your browser.
   

  

 Position
   

  

 PhD student in Atmospheric Sciences and Oceanography, focus on ML-methods in climate modelling
   

  

 Employer
   

  

 The Department of Meteorology, Stockholm University
   

  

**The Department of Meteorology** 
 at Stockholm University (MISU) conducts research and education spanning the atmosphere, ocean and physical climate sciences. MISU offers educational programmes at the Bachelor's, Master's and PhD levels. Our research addresses fundamental questions concerning the dynamics, physics, chemistry and biogeochemistry of the atmosphere and ocean relevant to weather and climate. MISU strives toward a broad representation of research within our scientific domain.
   

  

 We study questions originating from the deep ocean to the upper atmosphere and from the tropics to the poles. In this effort, we use and develop theory, statistical methods, and numerical models in close interplay with observations. We also develop and lead observational research using remote-sensing and in-situ measurements, including satellite missions and icebreaker expeditions to the Arctic.
   

  

 The department has around 60 employees and is embedded in a larger research environment, including the Bolin Centre for Climate Research, the Baltic Sea Centre and the Swedish e-Science Research Centre. The department is highly international, with over half of our employees coming from outside Sweden and both Swedish and English are used as working languages. We welcome and value diversity in our working environment.
   

  

 You can read more about us here: the Department of Meteorology.
   

  

 Homepage: https://www.su.se/english/divisions/department-of-meteorology
   

  

 Location
   

  

 Stockholm, Sweden
   

  

 Sector
   

  

 Academic
   

  

 Relevant divisions
   

  

 Atmospheric Sciences (AS)
   

  

 Ocean Sciences (OS)
   

  

 Type
   

  

 Full time
   

  

 Level
   

  

 Student / Graduate / Internship
   

  

 Salary
   

  

 Open
   

  

**Preferred Education**
 Master
   

  

 Application deadline
   

  

 3 November 2026
   

  

 Posted
   

  

 21 October 2026
   

  

**Job Description**
**Project description**
 Clouds and their responses to varying environmental conditions are particularly important determinants of current climate and future climate change. However, the resolution of a typical climate model is far too coarse to explicitly represent processes of relevance to cloud formation. Those processes therefore need to be parameterized, or represented as functions of large-scale state variables. Such sub-grid scale parameterizations are associated with large uncertainties, and are also computationally expensive.
   

  

 This project focuses on novel ways to bridge between micro- and global scales, to improve climate model accuracy, efficiency and generalizability, and leverage modern computer architecture. We will explore the use of machine learning (ML) models trained on combinations of observational data and high-resolution simulations, as alternatives to empirical parameterizations of essential, unresolved sub-grid scale processes related to turbulence, cloud formation and aerosol-cloud interaction. The tasks will include deriving and training data-driven models, coupling them to a large-scale climate model, evaluating the results against observations and traditionally parameterized models, and using the ML-enhanced model to estimate climate-relevant quantities like cloud radiative effects and forcing from aerosol-cloud interactions.
   

  

 The work will be carried out in close collaboration with data scientists within the Swedish e-Science Research Centre, and contribute to development of methods with applicability also beyond climate science. The successful candidate will thereby develop their skills in atmospheric science and climate modelling, but also in data science and machine learning, and in communicating and collaborating within and across disciplines.
   

  

**Qualification Requirements**
 In order to be admitted to postgraduate education, the applicant must have the general and specific entry requirements. The qualification requirements must be fulfilled before admission to the programme.
   

  

 You meet
 **general entry requirements** 
 if you have completed a second-cycle degree, or completed courses equivalent to at least 240 higher education credits, of which 60 credits must be in the second cycle, or have otherwise acquired equivalent knowledge in Sweden or elsewhere.
   

  

 The
 **specific entry requirements** 
 additionally require a minimum of 90 higher education credits in any of the fields of meteorology, oceanography, physics or chemistry; and at least 15 higher education credits in mathematics as well as a degree project of at least 15 higher education credits. At least 60 higher education credits of these courses must be on the second-cycle level. In addition, proficiency in English language, equivalent to English B in Swedish high school, is required.
   

  

 The specific entry requirements may also be fulfilled by a person who has otherwise acquired equivalent knowledge in Sweden or elsewhere.
   

  

 General syllabus for doctoral studies in atmospheric science and oceanography.
   

  

**Selection**
 The selection between candidates who meet the entry requirements will be made with reference to their ability to benefit from the training. However, the fact that an applicant is deemed able to transfer credits from previous training or professional experience may not alone give the applicant priority over other applicants in the selection process. Admission decisions are made in accordance with current delegation policies.
   

  

 The assessment criteria for admission to the postgraduate programme in atmospheric sciences and oceanography are familiarity with the theory and applications of the subject, subject knowledge relevant to the research project, the ability to express oneself orally and in writing, proficiency in English, analytical ability, creativity, initiative, independence and the ability to work collaboratively. The assessment of the applicant’s ability in these respects are based on the relevance and results of completed higher education courses, the quality and scope of the independent project, references, interviews and a personal statement from the applicant describing their expectations of, and intentions regarding, the programme.
   

  

 Admission Regulations for Doctoral Studies at Stockholm University.
   

  

**About The Employment**
 Starting date as per agreement. We offer a fixed-term employment as a doctoral student according to Chapter 5 of the Higher Education Ordinance (1993:100). The period of employment may not be longer than what corresponds to full-time doctoral education for four years. As a doctoral student, you should primarily devote yourself to your own doctoral education, but the employment may include work with education, research and administration to a limited extent (maximum 20 %).
   

  

 A new employment as a doctoral student is for a maximum of one year, the employment is then renewed for a maximum of two years at a time.
   

  

 Stockholm University strives to be a workplace free from discrimination and with equal opportunities for all.
   

  

**Contact**
 For more information about the project, please contact professor Frida Bender, frida.bender@misu.su.se.
   

  

 For more information about the PhD programme, please contact the study director, Associate Professor Thorsten Mauritsen thorsten.mauritsen@misu.su.se.
   

  

 For information about the recruitment process and terms of employment, please contact Head of Administration Sara Engström, sara.engstrom@misu.su.se.
   

  

**Application**
 Apply for the PhD student position at Stockholm University's recruitment system. Attach a personal letter and CV as well as the attachments requested in the application form. It is the responsibility of the applicant to ensure that the application is complete in accordance with the instructions in the job advertisement, and that it is submitted before the deadline.
   

  

 We kindly ask applicants to refrain from submitting AI-generated applications.

title: Account Manager
description:
TeamViewer provides a leading Digital Workplace platform that connects people with technology—enabling, improving and automating digital processes to make work work better. Our software solutions harness the power of AI and shape the future of digitalization.
   

  

 We believe that our diverse teams and strong company culture are key to the success of our products and technologies, that hundreds of millions of users around the world and around 645,000 customers across all industries rely on. With more than 1,900 employees worldwide, we celebrate the unique perspectives and talents that each individual brings to the table and foster a dynamic work environment where new ideas thrive. Are you ready to join our team and make an impact?
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Own a book of enterprise accounts as the sole account owner, with full accountability for gross retention, net revenue retention, and expansion.
* Build and maintain account plans for your key accounts: stakeholder maps, renewal timelines, adoption status, expansion hypotheses, and risk.
* Run every renewal in your book proactively, engaging well ahead of term end with a clear value narrative, and negotiate commercial terms including multi-year agreements.
* Identify, qualify, and close expansion opportunities — additional seats, products, and use cases — through a consultative, solutions-focused approach with IT and business stakeholders.
* Forecast weekly with accuracy: renewals and expansion by stage and category, with next steps and close dates current in Salesforce.
* Partner with Enterprise Solution Engineers on technical validation and solution design, and with Customer Success and Support to resolve issues that put retention at risk.
* Work with partners, distributors, and resellers on opportunities procured through the channel.
* Bring customer and market insight back to Product, Marketing, and leadership; contribute to references, case studies, and customer events.


**What Success Looks Like**
* Gross and net revenue retention at or above target across your book.
* Expansion quota attained, with a healthy, accurately forecast pipeline.
* Every account with a current plan and a known renewal path; no surprises at term end.
* Clean handoffs with the Account Executive and Specialist teams — nothing falling between roles.


**Requirements**
* 3+ years in enterprise account management, renewals, or customer-facing sales with existing customers; SaaS or technology required.
* A proven record of retaining and expanding a book of business against retention and expansion targets.
* Strong commercial skills: negotiation, multi-year structuring, and navigating procurement in mid-size and large organizations.
* Consultative, solutions-focused approach with the ability to engage IT leaders and business stakeholders on value and roadmap.
* Disciplined operator: weekly forecasting, account planning, and CRM hygiene (Salesforce).
* Excellent communication and presentation skills; comfortable in executive conversations.
* Entrepreneurial attitude with the ability to work in a rapidly changing, high-growth environment.


****What we offer****
* Onsite Onboarding in our HQ office for an optimal start
* Great compensation and benefits packages including company achievement bonus or sales bonus and regular salary reviews
* Premiums for the private pension plan (BAV) up to the maximum amount are topped up by TeamViewer
* Public transport friendly offices
* Option to lease an e-bike (Germany only)
* Special terms for local gyms
* Access to Corporate Benefits platform with many discounts
* Regular Team events and company-wide celebrations
* Open door policy, no dress code rules, frequent all Hands and Leadership Lunches
* Hybrid and Flexible work time
* Work From Abroad Program allowing up to 40 days of work outside your contracting country
* We celebrate diversity as one of core values, join and drive one of the c-a-r-e initiatives together with us!


 TeamViewer is an equal opportunities employer and is committed to building an inclusive culture where everyone feels welcome and supported. We C-A-R-E and understand that our diverse, values-driven culture makes us stronger. As we continue to grow as a company, we also focus on enabling our employees to grow both personally and professionally. We are proud to have an open and embracing workplace environment that will empower you to be your best no matter your gender, civil or family status, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, education level, or race.
   

  

 If you require any accommodations or adjustments during the application or hiring process, including interview or onboarding support, please reach out to your Talent Acquisition Partner, who will be happy to support you.

title: BI-konsult - Qlik, Power BI och dataflöden
description:
Vi söker en konsult som under några månader kan förstärka förmågan inom datadriven uppföljning och analys. Resursen kommer att arbeta nära medarbetare inom marknads- och ekonomifunktionerna. Konsulten ska både introducera nya, och vid behov dokumentera, samt förbättra etablerade arbetssätt.
   

  

 Uppdragets huvudsakliga innehåll
   

  

**Datapipelines och datakvalitet**
 Kartlägga relevanta datakällor och flöden, bygga eller förbättra datapipelines samt etablera kontroller för datakvalitet, spårbarhet och avvikelsehantering. Förståelse för datalager är också en fördel.
   

  

**Rapportering och analys**
 Vidareutveckla befintliga uppföljningsrapporter och ta fram nya rapporter i Qlik, med särskilt fokus på datakvalitet, användbar uppföljning och presentation.
   

  

**Strukturera och transformera**
 Genomföra analyser och undersökningar som omfattar stora datamängder, både gällande paneldata och annan data.
   

  

**Kompetensöverföring**
 Arbeta parallellt med interna resurser genom praktisk handledning, gemensam utveckling, dokumentation och utbildningsinsatser inom framför allt Qlik, men även Power BI kan vara aktuellt.
   

  

 Kompetenskrav
   

  

* Dokumenterad erfarenhet av att utveckla, driftsätta och förvalta dataflöden.
* God praktisk kompetens i Power BI, Qlik och Power Query.
* Erfarenhet av datamodellering, datatransformering och kvalitetssäkring av data.
* Erfarenhet av att utveckla uppföljningsrapporter, analysvyer och verktyg för användare i verksamheten.
* Förmåga att hantera och analysera stora datamängder på ett strukturerat och reproducerbart sätt.
* Förmåga att självständigt inventera verksamhetsbehov och omsätta dem till tekniska lösningar och prioriterade leveranser.
* Dokumenterad förmåga att kompetensöverföra genom exempelvis workshops, utbildning och tydlig teknisk dokumentation.


 Meriterande
   

  

* Erfarenhet av avräkning, ersättningsmodeller eller penningflöden där regelverk och fördelningslogik ligger till grund för beräkningarna.


 Omfattning
   

  

 Den exakta omfattningen av uppdraget behöver vara flexibel. Behovet bedöms motsvara cirka 20–50 % under några månaders tid. Efter en inledande fas där behov kartläggs och upplägg fastställs bör en mer konkret plan kunna beslutas. Start så snart som möjligt.
   

  

 Några dagar, framför allt i samband med uppstart, behöver genomföras på plats i Stockholm. I övrigt kan mycket av arbetet göras på distans.
   

  

**NÄR DU BLIR PARTNER**
 Som partnerkonsult hos Wise kliver du in i en gemenskap där samarbete är kärnan. Du får möjlighet att arbeta med några av marknadens mest intressanta uppdrag, i organisationer där både människor och teknik är i centrum. För oss är det avgörande att du känner dig trygg och värdesatt i vårt samarbete. Vi stöttar dig, coachar dig och finns med dig hela vägen genom uppdraget. Hos oss är du inte bara konsult – du blir en del av en större helhet.
   

  

**OM WISE IT**
 Wise IT är specialister på rekrytering, konsultlösningar och strategisk kompetensmatchning inom IT och tech. Teknik förändras snabbt , men med rätt person på rätt plats får du kontroll på framtiden. Vi matchar människor med skarp teknisk kompetens och förmågan att förstå helheten. Resultatet? IT som fungerar i praktiken, inte bara i teorin. Vi ser till att du inte bara följer utvecklingen utan driver den.
   

  

**DIN ANSÖKAN // TALENT SPEAKS LOUDER**
 För att söka rollen klicka på ”Ansök nu”, samt bifoga CV. Notera att vi ej kan ta emot ansökningar via mail. I konsultvärden går det ofta snabbt så tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdatum. Vänta därför inte med din ansökan.

title: Major Account Manager - Defense & Large Authorities
description:
**Our Mission**
 At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.
   

  

**Who We Are**
 In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!
   

  

 This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 The Major Account Manager Defense & Large Authorities partners with our Public sector customers to secure their entire digital experience. You’re motivated by the desire to solve critical challenges facing our customer’s secure environment, so you’re prepared to connect them with a solution for every stage of threat prevention. This role is a significant driver of company revenue and growth. As an experienced and dynamic sales professional, you’re responsible for leading and driving sales engagements.
   

  

 Palo Alto Networks is leading the charge in platformization, offering best-in-breed solutions that enable customers to build a truly zero-trust security architecture and navigate critical transformations. To ensure our sales team is equipped to guide customers, we've developed FLIGHT, an immersive onboarding program. Flight blends virtual and in-person learning at our headquarters, where new sales hires will participate in dynamic cohorts, fully dedicated to their training without customer distractions. This focused approach ensures they emerge as well-prepared sales professionals, ready to help customers leverage our comprehensive portfolio.
   

  

 Your Impact
   

  

 As a Major Account Manager Defense & Large Authorities, you will drive and orchestrate large complex sales cycles and work with our internal partners and teams to best serve the customer
   

  

 Your consultative selling experience will identify business challenges and create
   

  

 solutions for prospects and our customers
   

  

 Understand the competitive landscape and customer needs so you can effectively position the portfolio of Palo Alto Networks solutions
   

  

 Create clear goals and complete accurate forecasting through developing a detailed territory plan
   

  

 Leverage prospect stories to create a compelling value proposition with insights into value for that specific account
   

  

 Stay updated on industry news and trends, and how they affect Palo Alto Networks products and services
   

  

 Travel as necessary within your territory, and to company-wide meetings
   

  

**Qualifications**
 Experience and knowledge of selling large Enterprise IT solutions to large Public sector customers.
   

  

 Fluent Swedish.
   

  

 Demonstrated experience selling complex solutions, value selling, and/or consultative sales techniques
   

  

 Technical aptitude for understanding how technology products and solutions solve business problems
   

  

 Identifies problems, reviews data, determines the root causes, and provides scalable solutions
   

  

 Cultivate relationships with our channel partners to bring channel-centric go-to-market approach for our customers
   

  

 Demonstrates in depth knowledge of the full sales cycle and the ability to follow a structured sales process
   

  

 Ability to take a holistic approach to problem solving by understanding the bigger picture, and considering complex interrelationships and outcomes
   

  

 Excellent time management skills, and work with high levels of autonomy and self-direction
   

  

**Our Commitment**
 We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.
   

  

 We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at accommodations@paloaltonetworks.com.
   

  

 Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.
   

  

 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
   

  

 Is role eligible for Immigration Sponsorship? No. Please note that we will not sponsor applicants for work visas for this position.

title: Enterprise Networking Support Engineer
description:

 At Ubiquiti Inc., we create technology platforms for Businesses, Smart Homes, and Internet Service Providers, driven by our goal to connect everyone, everywhere. To date, Ubiquiti has shipped over 100 million devices worldwide, from ISP networking products to next generation of IT solutions. Our growth is made possible by the dedicated team of hundreds behind the scenes. From software developers and product managers to designers and strategists, Team UI is driven to achieve our common goal: Rethinking IT. At Ubiquiti, you’ll heighten your potential and broaden your horizons - all while shaping the future of connectivity.
   

  

**Join forces with us on our mission to build a better IT industry. We are currently looking for a highly skilled Enterprise Networking Support Engineer to our team in Stockholm, Sweden.**

title: Erfaren managementkonsult inom Business Transformation & Analysis
description:
Vill du använda din erfarenhet för att skapa verklig förändring – tillsammans med kunder och kollegor som delar din nyfikenhet och ambition? På Knowit Ascend får du möjlighet att utveckla verksamheter, människor och dig själv i en entreprenöriell miljö där vi bygger nästa steg tillsammans.
   

  

 Vi fortsätter att utveckla och bredda vårt erbjudande och söker nu erfarna managementkonsulter som vill växa tillsammans med oss och vara med och forma nästa kapitel för Knowit Ascend.
   

  

 Som managementkonsulter inom Business Transformation & Analysis kombinerar vi strategisk, operativ och analytisk erfarenhet med förmågan att tillsammans med våra kunder omsätta strategi i konkreta resultat. Hos oss blir du en del av ett sammansvetsat och icke-hierarkiskt team där olika bakgrunder och kompetenser möts – och där vi både utmanar, stöttar och utvecklar varandra.
   

  

**Önskad kompetens och erfarenhet**
 Du förstår vad som krävs för att skapa förändring som håller över tid och leder till verklig verksamhetsnytta. Du drivs av att utveckla både verksamheter och människor och har erfarenhet inom ett eller flera av våra erbjudandeområden:
   

  

* Strategy & Growth
* Tech Transformation
* Commercial Excellence
* Operational Performance


 Vi söker dig som har erfarenhet av komplexa transformationsinitiativ och som trivs med att växla mellan strategiskt tänkande och konkret genomförande. Du är van att skapa riktning, få människor med dig och omsätta analys till resultat som märks i verksamheten. Din erfarenhet kan exempelvis omfatta att:
   

  

* Driva organisationsutveckling, inklusive att utforma och implementera nya verksamhets- och styrmodeller (operating models)
* Utveckla strategier, målbilder och handlingsplaner och omsätta dem i konkret genomförande
* Leda transformationsinitiativ med fokus på långsiktigt värdeskapande och verksamhetseffekt
* Använda teknik, data och AI för att utveckla verksamheter och skapa värde av digitala investeringar
* Utveckla kommersiella förmågor, exempelvis inom Commercial Excellence och Sales Excellence, och stärka organisationens förmåga att driva förändring


 Vi tror att du kommer att trivas hos oss om du kombinerar gedigen konsulterfarenhet med nyfikenhet, affärsdriv och en vilja att utvecklas tillsammans med andra. Vi söker dig som:
   

  

* Har 6–12 års erfarenhet av arbete som managementkonsult eller liknande roller
* Har med dig managementkonsultens verktygslåda och ett starkt engagemang för att stötta våra kunder på deras transformationsresor
* Har ett starkt driv inom försäljning och affärsutveckling, kombinerat med praktisk erfarenhet och god kommersiell förståelse
* Trivs i en entreprenöriell miljö och vill vara med och utveckla vårt team och vårt erbjudande
* Har ett inkluderande förhållningssätt och mycket god ledarskapsförmåga
* Uppskattar att arbeta i team, tillsammans med både kollegor och kunder
* Gillar att prestera, men också att ha kul längs vägen
* Talar och skriver obehindrat på svenska och engelska samt bor i Stockholmsområdet


 Vi utgår från våra kunder och arbetar flexibelt tillsammans för att skapa bästa möjliga resultat. Samtidigt värnar vi om ett hållbart arbetsliv och möjligheten att få ihop arbete och privatliv. Våra kunder finns huvudsakligen i Storstockholmsområdet.
   

  

**Om Knowit och Knowit Ascend**
 Du blir en del av Knowits dotterbolag Knowit Ascend, där vi hjälper våra kunder inom Business Transformation & Analysis. Knowit Ascend består av cirka 60 managementkonsulter med bas i Stockholm. Som ett sammansvetsat team i ett större ekosystem kombinerar vi det mindre bolagets snabbhet och flexibilitet med den större organisationens styrka och resurser.
   

  

 Knowit är ett nordiskt konsultbolag som hjälper företag, myndigheter och organisationer att lyckas i den digitala transformationen. Med expertis inom systemutveckling, AI, cybersäkerhet, molntjänster, digitala kundupplevelser och managementkonsulting utvecklar vi lösningar som bidrar till ett mer hållbart och mänskligt samhälle.
   

  

 Vi är cirka 2 100 kollegor i Sverige inklusive Polen med ytterligare 1 500 kollegor i Norge, Finland, Danmark, Tyskland och Serbien.

title: Founding Enterprise Account Executive
description:
**Job Title** 
 : Founding Enterprise Account Executive
 



**Location** 
 : Stockholm
 



  





**Our Mission:** 




 Omnea is the agentic operating system for procurement.
 



  





 Procurement touches every pound a business spends, yet requests still stall for weeks and approvals get lost in inboxes. Our AI-first platform changes that: our agents capture requests, route approvals, onboard suppliers, flag risk and track every renewal, while anyone in the business can ask a question and get an answer grounded in their own company’s data. Buying becomes painless for everyone, procurement gets a seat at the table, and our customers have saved more than 100,000 hours of manual work so far.
 



  





 Companies like Spotify, PayPal, T. Rowe Price, JustEat, Adyen and S&P Global run procurement on Omnea. We’re backed by $75M from Khosla Ventures, Insight Partners and Accel, and we’ve been named the UK’s number one startup in the Startups 100, ranked 11th on Sifted’s 2026 list of Europe’s fastest-growing companies, and recognised as one of Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies.
 



  





 Talent density matters more to us than almost anything else. We keep the bar high in every team, so everyone here has real ownership and real impact. Our team is full of former founders and operators who’ve scaled unicorns, and we’re looking for people who want to do the best work of their careers alongside them.
 



  





 Find out more about the team and life at Omnea here.
 



  





**The role in one line** 




 Be Omnea's first Enterprise Account Executive in the Nordic region, as one of Europe's fastest-growing AI companies expands globally.
 



  





**Why now** 




 Omnea is the UK's number one startup for 2026 and the 11th fastest-growing tech company in Europe. We're in the middle of a major global expansion and hiring Enterprise Account Executives to lead it in each region. The product, customers and sales motion are proven.
 



  





 What's missing is the person who takes them into the Nordic region.
 


* We win 86% of live RFPs against our biggest competitor
* More than 3x ARR growth in the last 12 months, with 40% in Q3 alone
* Under 20% of enterprises use modern procurement software today. Gartner expects that to reach 50% by 2027
* Global enterprises including Spotify, Wise, Adecco and McAfee already run on Omnea



  





**What you'll do** 



* Open the Nordic region from Copenhagen or Stockholm: build pipeline, run complex enterprise cycles and close our first wave of local customers
* Run multi-stakeholder new business deals across Finance, Procurement, Legal, Security and IT, from first meeting to signature
* Shape how Omnea goes to market in the Nordic region: messaging, target verticals, partners and events
* Take what you hear from buyers straight to product and engineering, and see it shipped
* Lay the foundations for the team that follows you



  





**Who this is for** 



* 3 to 7 years in B2B SaaS sales, with a record of closing enterprise new business in the Nordic region
* Fluent Danish or Swedish, plus English
* Consistently at or near the top of the leaderboard
* Comfortable building pipeline from zero, before there's a local team around you
* At home in long, complex cycles and the stakeholders that come with them
* Bonus: you've been an early hire, a founding rep or a founder before



  





**Where this goes** 




 We run as a meritocracy, and the trajectory scales with the market you build. As the Nordic region grows, there's a clear path into bigger accounts and leading the team that follows you. We've also signed the Future Founder Promise, so if you want to start your own company one day, we'll back that too.
 



  





**How you'll work** 




 This role is remote while we build our presence in the Nordic region.
 



  





  





 At Omnea, we embrace diversity. To build a product that's loved by everyone, we're best served by a team with all sorts of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't quite match the full job spec! And regardless of your race, religion, colour, gender, or anything else! If you think you could be a good fit for Omnea, please reach out.

title: Information Security & Compliance Intern

 This is an excellent opportunity to gain hands-on experience in a fast-evolving field while making a real contribution to the business. As part of the team, you will help drive our compliance roadmap forward, support stakeholders with timely guidance, and bring fresh perspectives informed by your academic studies. At the same time, you will develop valuable skills and build a strong foundation for a future career in information security, compliance, and governance. 
 



  
 



**Who you are**

 You are curious, detail-oriented, and enjoy working in a structured way. You communicate clearly, take ownership of your work, and are eager to learn while contributing to meaningful projects. 
 



 Fluency in English is required. Swedish is a plus. 
 



**It’s a bonus if you have:** 



* Coursework, projects, or certifications in information security or privacy


* Basic knowledge of GDPR or ISO 27001


* Familiarity with Microsoft 365 or cloud environments



 Most importantly, you have a strong willingness to learn and an interest in building a career within information security, risk, privacy, or compliance. 
   

  





 As our Information Security & Compliance Intern, you will work closely with the Global Director of Information Security & Compliance and gain hands-on experience across security, privacy, and risk management. 
 



**In this role, you will:** 



* Support with assessments and reviews for new systems, vendors, and AI solutions


* Review and update security policies, standards, and procedures


* Assist with risk management activities, reporting, and documentation


* Conduct security and privacy assessments of third-party vendors


* Help create security awareness content for colleagues across the business


* Support ongoing security, compliance, and business continuity initiatives

And there’s plenty to enjoy along the way, from a generous discount on Gant collections to office activities and moments that bring colleagues together.

 We’d love to hear from you. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis, so we encourage you to apply early. For the opportunity to gain hands-on experience in a global fashion environment, submit your application today.
